It integrates time-dependent 4D Gaussians, decomposes static and dynamic components, and distills 2D foundation model features, achieving accurate reconstruction and novel view synthesis in dynamic urban scenes.
2411.15482|v2.assessment: 该论文针对自动驾驶动态场景重建提出自监督方案，消除标注依赖，方法设计巧妙，对4D重建和感知有重要参考。
2411.15482|v2.contribution: 提出自监督动态高斯泼溅框架SplatFlow，在神经运动流场中学习4D时空表示。
2411.15482|v2.innovation: 利用NMFF建模连续运动流场，结合2D基础模型蒸馏提升动态物体识别。
2411.15482|v2.result: 在动态场景重建和新视角合成上超越现有方法，无需目标级标注。

SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.summary_cn: ①针对目标检测中骨干网络设计依赖人工且搜索效率低的问题。②提出SP-NAS，采用串行到并行的搜索策略，在检测任务上直接搜索骨干网络结构。③相比传统NAS方法，通过分阶段搜索和性能评估策略，提高了搜索效率和检测精度。④在COCO数据集上取得了有竞争力的检测性能，但摘要中未提供具体数据。
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of manual backbone design for object detection by proposing SP-NAS, a serial-to-parallel search strategy that directly optimizes backbone architectures for detection. It improves search efficiency and detection accuracy through staged search and performance evaluation, achieving competitive results on COCO, though specific metrics are not detailed in the abstract.
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.assessment: 该论文聚焦检测任务中的骨干网络搜索，但摘要信息有限，创新性和效果展示不够充分。
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.contribution: 提出面向目标检测的串行到并行骨干网络搜索方法。
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.innovation: 采用串行到并行的搜索策略，结合检测任务特性优化骨干结构。
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.result: 在COCO上取得有竞争力的检测性能，但具体数据未在摘要中给出。
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear._arxiv_id: SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Search for Object Detection.

1906.04423|v2.summary_cn: ①针对目标检测中NAS方法计算资源消耗大、搜索效率低的问题。②提出NAS-FCOS，在无锚检测器FCOS上搜索特征金字塔网络和预测头结构，采用定制强化学习范式。③通过精心设计的搜索空间、搜索算法和评估策略，显著降低了搜索成本。④在8块V100 GPU上仅用4天完成搜索，发现的架构在AP上超越Faster R-CNN、RetinaNet和FCOS等SOTA模型1.5至3.5个百分点。
1906.04423|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the high computational cost of NAS for object detection by proposing NAS-FCOS, which searches the FPN and prediction head of the anchor-free FCOS detector using tailored reinforcement learning. With carefully designed search space and evaluation strategies, it completes search in 4 days on 8 V100 GPUs, and the discovered architecture surpasses SOTA detectors like Faster R-CNN, RetinaNet, and FCOS by 1.5 to 3.5 AP points.
1906.04423|v2.assessment: 该论文在检测NAS领域具有重要价值，搜索效率高且性能提升显著，是高效NAS的典型代表。
1906.04423|v2.contribution: 提出首个面向无锚检测器的快速NAS方法，搜索FPN和预测头结构。
1906.04423|v2.innovation: 将NAS应用于检测解码器，结合强化学习和高效评估策略，大幅降低搜索成本。
1906.04423|v2.result: 搜索架构在COCO上AP超越SOTA检测器1.5-3.5个百分点。

1906.09607|v2.summary_cn: ①针对现有NAS方法中块数量和宽度需手动设置，限制网络规模搜索灵活性的问题。②提出DenseNAS，设计密集连接搜索空间，通过路由块构建超网络，并搜索块间最优路径。③引入链式成本估计算法，在搜索中同时优化精度和模型成本。④在ImageNet上，基于MobileNetV2搜索空间，DenseNAS达到75.3% top-1准确率，仅需361MB FLOPs和17.9ms延迟；更大模型达到76.1%准确率，仅需479M FLOPs。
1906.09607|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the manual setting of block counts and widths in NAS by proposing DenseNAS, which designs a densely connected search space with routing blocks and searches for optimal paths. A chained cost estimation algorithm optimizes both accuracy and model cost. DenseNAS achieves 75.3% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet with 361MB FLOPs and 17.9ms latency, and 76.1% accuracy with 479M FLOPs for a larger model.
1906.09607|v2.assessment: 该论文通过密集连接搜索空间提升了NAS的灵活性，在精度和效率上均表现优异，值得关注。
1906.09607|v2.contribution: 提出密集连接搜索空间和链式成本估计算法，实现块数量和宽度的联合搜索。
1906.09607|v2.innovation: 设计路由块和密集连接超网络，突破传统NAS对块配置的手动限制。
1906.09607|v2.result: 在ImageNet上以低FLOPs和延迟实现高精度，性能优于基线。

2008.06120|v2.summary_cn: ①针对权重共享NAS方法是否优于随机搜索的争议问题。②通过系统比较高效NAS和随机搜索在多个图像分类和检测搜索空间上的表现，并提出改进技术。③实验表明在大型现实任务中，高效搜索方法可显著优于随机搜索，且改进技术提升架构质量并减少手动调参。④在ImageNet和COCO上验证了方法的有效性，但摘要未提供具体性能数据。
2008.06120|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates whether weight-sharing NAS outperforms random search by conducting thorough comparisons on progressively larger search spaces for image classification and detection. Experiments show efficient search can provide substantial gains over random search on large realistic tasks, and proposed techniques improve architecture quality and reduce manual tuning. Specific metrics are not detailed in the abstract.
2008.06120|v2.assessment: 该论文为NAS领域的基础问题提供了实证分析，对理解高效搜索方法的优势有重要参考价值。
2008.06120|v2.contribution: 系统比较了权重共享NAS与随机搜索，并提出改进搜索质量的技巧。
2008.06120|v2.innovation: 通过大规模实验验证高效NAS的实用性，并引入减少调参的技术。
2008.06120|v2.result: 在大型任务上高效搜索优于随机搜索，但具体数据未在摘要中给出。

2003.14058|v2.summary_cn: ①针对通用多任务学习中NAS搜索空间依赖任务组合、难以泛化的问题。②提出MTL-NAS，将多任务网络分解为单任务骨干，并设计任务无关的搜索空间，插入跨任务特征融合边。③提出单次梯度搜索算法，通过最小熵正则化使架构权重收敛到近离散值，实现搜索后直接评估。④实验表明搜索模型无需从头训练即可使用，但摘要未提供具体性能数据。
2003.14058|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the task-dependence of NAS search spaces in general-purpose multi-task learning by proposing MTL-NAS, which disentangles networks into single-task backbones and designs a task-agnostic search space with cross-task fusion edges. A single-shot gradient search with minimum entropy regularization enables direct evaluation without retraining. Experiments demonstrate effectiveness, though specific metrics are not detailed.
2003.14058|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地将NAS扩展到多任务学习，提出任务无关搜索空间和高效搜索算法，具有较高学术价值。
2003.14058|v2.contribution: 提出面向通用多任务学习的任务无关NAS方法和单次搜索算法。
2003.14058|v2.innovation: 通过层级特征共享和最小熵正则化，实现多任务架构的高效搜索和直接部署。
2003.14058|v2.result: 搜索模型可直接评估，但具体性能数据未在摘要中给出。

1912.02037|v2.summary_cn: ①针对GAN架构设计依赖人工且现有NAS方法不适用于生成模型的问题。②提出AdversarialNAS，首次以可微分方式同时搜索生成器和判别器架构，无需额外评估指标。③搜索算法考虑两个网络的相关性和平衡性，效率极高。④在CIFAR-10上，仅用1 GPU天完成搜索，发现模型FID达到10.87，Inception Score达到8.74，刷新SOTA，并验证了迁移性。
1912.02037|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the manual design of GAN architectures by proposing AdversarialNAS, the first method to simultaneously search generator and discriminator architectures in a differentiable manner without extra metrics. The search considers network relevance and balance, achieving high efficiency. On CIFAR-10, it completes search in 1 GPU day, achieving a SOTA FID of 10.87 and Inception Score of 8.74, with transferability demonstrated.
1912.02037|v2.assessment: 该论文将NAS成功应用于GAN，搜索效率极高且性能卓越，对生成模型自动化设计有重要贡献。
1912.02037|v2.contribution: 提出首个可微分联合搜索GAN生成器和判别器架构的方法。
1912.02037|v2.innovation: 设计对抗搜索算法，无需额外评估指标，同时优化网络平衡性。
1912.02037|v2.result: 在CIFAR-10上以1 GPU天搜索，FID 10.87和IS 8.74刷新SOTA。

1911.10695|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对神经网络架构搜索（NAS）中忽视对抗鲁棒性的问题，即搜索到的架构在对抗攻击下性能脆弱。②提出了在NAS过程中引入鲁棒性约束，通过联合优化架构和鲁棒性指标来搜索抗攻击的架构。③相比传统NAS仅关注准确率，该方法将鲁棒性作为搜索目标之一，提高了架构的防御能力。④摘要未提供具体数据，但强调了鲁棒性与准确率的权衡。
1911.10695|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of neural architecture search (NAS) neglecting adversarial robustness, proposing to incorporate robustness constraints into the search process. It jointly optimizes architecture and robustness metrics to find architectures resilient to attacks. Compared to traditional NAS focusing solely on accuracy, it enhances defense capability. Specific results are not provided in the abstract.
1911.10695|v2.assessment: 该论文将鲁棒性引入NAS，对安全敏感应用有价值，但摘要信息有限，需进一步验证。
1911.10695|v2.contribution: 提出在NAS中考虑对抗鲁棒性的新视角。
1911.10695|v2.innovation: 将鲁棒性指标融入架构搜索目标。
1911.10695|v2.result: 未提供具体数据，但展示了鲁棒性与准确率的权衡。

2003.12238|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对NAS中双层优化近似导致梯度误差和次优解的问题。②提出了混合层级重构（MiLeNAS），将双层优化转化为混合层级优化，可用简单一阶方法高效求解。③相比DARTS等双层方法，MiLeNAS降低了验证误差，并通过模型大小搜索和早停策略在约5小时内完成搜索。④实验表明，MiLeNAS在卷积搜索空间中获得更高准确率。
2003.12238|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses gradient errors and suboptimality in bilevel optimization for NAS, proposing a mixed-level reformulation (MiLeNAS) that enables efficient first-order optimization. It achieves lower validation errors and higher accuracies than bilevel methods, with search completed in about 5 hours via model size-based search and early stopping.
2003.12238|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了一种高效的NAS优化框架，对提升搜索效率和性能有显著贡献。
2003.12238|v2.contribution: 提出混合层级优化方法，解决NAS双层优化的近似问题。

2002.09128|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对NAS两阶段参数优化中架构性能相关性差的问题，提出任务特定端到端的新问题定义。②提出了DSNAS，一种高效可微NAS框架，通过低偏差蒙特卡洛估计同时优化架构和参数，无需重新训练。③相比两阶段方法，DSNAS直接部署子网络，减少总计算量。④在ImageNet上达到74.4%准确率，仅需420 GPU小时，总时间减少34%以上。
2002.09128|v2.summary_en: This paper redefines NAS as task-specific end-to-end optimization, proposing DSNAS that simultaneously optimizes architecture and parameters via low-biased Monte Carlo estimation, eliminating retraining. It achieves 74.4% accuracy on ImageNet in 420 GPU hours, reducing total time by over 34% compared to two-stage methods.
2002.09128|v2.assessment: 该论文提出端到端NAS新范式，显著提升效率，对实际应用有重要价值。
2002.09128|v2.contribution: 提出无需重训的直接NAS框架，重新定义NAS问题。
2002.09128|v2.innovation: 低偏差蒙特卡洛估计实现架构和参数联合优化。
2002.09128|v2.result: ImageNet准确率74.4%，总时间减少34%以上。

2004.01961|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对非局部（NL）块计算量大且难以嵌入移动网络的问题。②提出了轻量级非局部块（LightNL）和AutoNL搜索算法，通过压缩变换和紧凑特征降低计算成本。③LightNL比传统NL块计算量便宜400倍，且不牺牲性能。④AutoNL在32 GPU小时内搜索的模型在ImageNet上达到77.7% top-1准确率，FLOPs为350M。
2004.01961|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the heavy computation of Non-Local blocks, proposing LightNL blocks with 400x lower cost and an efficient NAS algorithm (AutoNL) to learn optimal configurations. The searched model achieves 77.7% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet with 350M FLOPs in 32 GPU hours.
2004.01961|v2.assessment: 该论文解决了NL块在移动端的应用难题，兼具高效性和性能，具有实用价值。
2004.01961|v2.contribution: 提出轻量级NL块和端到端NAS搜索方法。
2004.01961|v2.innovation: 通过结构松弛和紧凑特征设计实现高效NL块搜索。

Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient supervision in NAS, proposing block-wise supervision with knowledge distillation to provide fine-grained guidance during search. It enhances generalization and efficiency, though specific results are not detailed in the abstract.
Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect.assessment: 该论文提出块级监督策略，对NAS训练有潜在改进，但摘要信息不足。
Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect.contribution: 引入块级监督和知识蒸馏到NAS流程。
Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect.innovation: 细粒度监督信号提升搜索指导。

1912.00195|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对NAS搜索阶段验证准确率与最终评估不一致的问题。②提出了顺序贪婪架构搜索（SGAS），将搜索过程分解为子问题，贪心选择并剪枝候选操作。③相比传统NAS，SGAS提高了泛化能力，适用于CNN和GCN。④实验在图像分类、点云分类和蛋白质交互图节点分类上取得最先进结果，计算成本低。
1912.00195|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the generalization gap in NAS, proposing sequential greedy architecture search (SGAS) that divides search into subproblems and greedily prunes operations. It achieves state-of-the-art results on image, point cloud, and graph classification with minimal computational cost.
1912.00195|v2.assessment: 该论文提出简单有效的贪心搜索策略，显著提升NAS泛化性，应用广泛。
1912.00195|v2.contribution: 提出顺序贪心搜索方法，缓解NAS泛化问题。
1912.00195|v2.innovation: 将搜索分解为子问题并贪心剪枝。
1912.00195|v2.result: 在多个任务上取得最先进性能，计算成本低。

1909.06793|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对实时语义分割网络设计中性能与速度难以平衡且依赖人工经验的问题。②提出图引导架构搜索（GAS）方法，引入新的搜索空间，通过细胞独立方式消除细胞共享约束，并集成图卷积网络（GCN）作为细胞间通信机制，同时加入延迟导向约束。③相比以往工作，GAS支持细胞级多样性，并通过GCN增强细胞间信息交互，且显式优化延迟。④在Cityscapes和CamVid数据集上，GAS实现了精度与速度的新最优权衡。
1909.06793|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of balancing performance and speed in real-time semantic segmentation network design, which often relies on empirical trials. It proposes Graph-guided Architecture Search (GAS) with a novel search space, cell-independent design for diversity, GCN-based communication, and latency-oriented constraints. GAS achieves state-of-the-art accuracy-speed trade-offs on Cityscapes and CamVid datasets.
1909.06793|v2.assessment: 该论文在NAS应用于实时语义分割方面具有创新性，通过图引导机制和延迟约束有效提升搜索效率，值得关注。
1909.06793|v2.contribution: 提出GAS方法，实现实时语义分割网络的自动化搜索。
1909.06793|v2.innovation: 引入GCN作为细胞间通信机制，并采用延迟导向约束。
1909.06793|v2.result: 在Cityscapes和CamVid上达到新的精度-速度权衡。

1912.07651|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对可微分NAS（DNAS）只能优化可微损失函数且需精确近似非可微标准的问题。②提出UNAS统一框架，融合DNAS和强化学习（RL）方法，支持在统一框架中搜索可微和非可微标准，并引入基于泛化差距的新目标函数防止过拟合。③相比已有工作，UNAS结合了DNAS的低搜索成本和RL的灵活性，并改进搜索目标。④在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和ImageNet上，UNAS在多个搜索空间中获得最先进平均精度。
1912.07651|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of differentiable NAS (DNAS) in optimizing only differentiable losses and requiring accurate approximations for non-differentiable criteria. It proposes UNAS, a unified framework combining DNAS and RL-based methods, enabling search with both differentiable and non-differentiable objectives, and introduces a generalization-gap-based objective to prevent overfitting. UNAS achieves state-of-the-art average accuracy on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and ImageNet across multiple search spaces.
1912.07651|v2.assessment: 该论文在NAS方法论上具有重要贡献，统一了DNAS和RL，并引入泛化差距目标，实验充分，值得关注。
1912.07651|v2.contribution: 提出UNAS统一框架，整合DNAS和RL，支持多类型搜索标准。
1912.07651|v2.innovation: 引入基于泛化差距的新目标函数，并实现可微与非可微标准的统一搜索。
1912.07651|v2.result: 在多个数据集上取得最先进平均精度。

2004.05565|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对DNAS搜索空间小、内存和计算开销大的瓶颈。②提出DMaskingNAS算法，通过掩码机制实现特征图重用，扩展搜索空间至空间和通道维度（如输入分辨率和滤波器数量），并采用有效形状传播最大化每FLOP或每参数精度。③相比传统DNAS，搜索空间扩大10^14倍，而内存和计算成本几乎不变。④搜索的FBNetV2模型在性能上超越先前架构，搜索成本降低421倍，精度提升0.9%，FLOPs减少15%（相比MobileNetV3-Small），或精度相似但FLOPs减少20%（相比Efficient-B0）。
2004.05565|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the bottleneck of small search spaces and high memory/computation costs in differentiable NAS. It proposes DMaskingNAS with a masking mechanism for feature map reuse, expanding the search space by up to 10^14 times over conventional DNAS, supporting spatial and channel dimensions, and using effective shape propagation. The searched FBNetV2 models achieve state-of-the-art performance with up to 421x less search cost, 0.9% higher accuracy, and 15% fewer FLOPs than MobileNetV3-Small, or similar accuracy with 20% fewer FLOPs than Efficient-B0.
2004.05565|v2.assessment: 该论文在DNAS效率方面有显著创新，大幅扩展搜索空间同时保持低成本，实验结果有力，值得关注。
2004.05565|v2.contribution: 提出DMaskingNAS，实现大规模搜索空间的高效DNAS。
2004.05565|v2.innovation: 掩码机制实现特征图重用，支持空间和通道维度搜索。
2004.05565|v2.result: FBNetV2在多个基准上达到最先进性能，搜索成本大幅降低。

1909.04977|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对现有NAS算法中搜索技术主要由可微分方法主导的问题。②提出CARS连续进化方法，在种群中共享参数的SuperNet上训练架构，并继承SuperNet和种群进行下一代搜索，采用非支配排序保留Pareto前沿结果。③相比可微分方法，CARS提供了一种高效的连续进化策略，避免了对可微性的依赖。④在ImageNet上，CARS仅用0.4 GPU天搜索，生成参数范围3.7M至5.1M的系列网络，性能超越最先进方法。
1909.04977|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the dominance of differentiable methods in NAS by developing an efficient continuous evolutionary approach. CARS tunes architectures sharing parameters in a SuperNet, inherits both SuperNet and population across generations, and uses non-dominated sorting for Pareto front preservation. With only 0.4 GPU days, CARS produces networks with 3.7M-5.1M parameters that surpass state-of-the-art methods on ImageNet.
1909.04977|v2.assessment: 该论文在NAS进化方法上具有创新性，通过连续进化策略实现高效搜索，实验证明其有效性，值得关注。
1909.04977|v2.contribution: 提出CARS连续进化NAS方法，实现高效架构搜索。
1909.04977|v2.innovation: 结合SuperNet参数共享和连续进化，采用非支配排序。
1909.04977|v2.result: 在ImageNet上以极低搜索成本超越最先进方法。

Memory-Efficient Hierarchical Neural Arc.summary_en: This paper addresses the memory inefficiency in neural architecture search (NAS) for image denoising. It proposes a memory-efficient hierarchical NAS method that reduces memory consumption via a hierarchical search strategy. Compared to existing NAS approaches, it maintains search performance while significantly lowering memory usage. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract details.

Memory-Efficient Hierarchical Neural Arc.contribution: 提出了一种内存高效的层次化NAS方法，用于图像去噪。
Memory-Efficient Hierarchical Neural Arc.innovation: 通过层次化搜索策略降低内存消耗。

2005.09917|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对NAS中性能估计（PE）耗时且不可或缺的问题，提出在资源受限条件下的预算性能估计（BPE）框架。②通过最小重要性剪枝（MIP）方法，利用随机森林估计超参数重要性并迭代剪枝，以高效探索BPE搜索空间。③相比已有PE方法，BPE结合多种搜索算法（如强化学习、进化算法、随机搜索和可微搜索）实现了1000倍加速，且性能下降可忽略。④实验表明，该方法在保持SOTA性能的同时大幅提升搜索效率。
2005.09917|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the time-consuming performance estimation (PE) in NAS by proposing a budgeted PE (BPE) framework under resource constraints. It introduces Minimum Importance Pruning (MIP) to estimate hyperparameter importance via random forest and prune less important ones iteratively. Combined with various search algorithms, BPE achieves 1000x speedup with negligible performance drop compared to SOTA.
2005.09917|v2.assessment: 该论文系统性地重新思考了NAS中的性能估计问题，提出的BPE框架具有显著效率提升，对NAS领域有重要贡献。
2005.09917|v2.contribution: 提出了预算性能估计（BPE）框架和最小重要性剪枝（MIP）方法，实现高效NAS。
2005.09917|v2.innovation: 利用随机森林估计超参数重要性并迭代剪枝，优化资源分配。
2005.09917|v2.result: 实现1000倍NAS加速，性能下降可忽略。

2001.01233|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对NAS中训练和评估候选架构耗时的问题，提出使用代理（proxy）来降低计算成本。②通过系统研究多种代理的排名一致性，提出了一种可靠的代理和层次化代理策略，优先计算潜在更准确的候选网络，早期丢弃无望的候选。③相比已有代理方法，该策略在保持排名一致性的同时提高了搜索效率。④基于此的进化NAS（EcoNAS）实现了400倍加速，且性能损失极小。
2001.01233|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the time-consuming training and evaluation in NAS by using proxies. It systematically investigates proxy behaviors and proposes a reliable proxy with a hierarchical strategy that allocates more computation to promising candidates and discards unpromising ones early. The resulting EcoNAS achieves 400x speedup with minimal performance loss.
2001.01233|v2.assessment: 该论文对代理在NAS中的行为进行了系统分析，提出的层次化策略具有实用价值，适合NAS效率优化研究。
2001.01233|v2.contribution: 提出了可靠的代理和层次化代理策略，用于经济高效的NAS。
2001.01233|v2.innovation: 基于代理排名一致性分析，设计层次化计算分配策略。
2001.01233|v2.result: EcoNAS实现400倍加速，性能损失极小。

Stabilizing Differentiable Architecture.summary_en: This paper addresses the instability in differentiable architecture search (DARTS). It proposes a perturbation-based regularization method to stabilize the search process. Compared to existing DARTS variants, it enhances robustness via perturbation regularization. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract details.

Stabilizing Differentiable Architecture.innovation: 通过扰动正则化增强搜索鲁棒性。

2103.10584|v2.summary_cn: ①针对硬件感知神经架构搜索（HW-NAS）中硬件成本获取困难、基准测试不可复现的问题。②构建了首个公开的HW-NAS基准数据集HW-NAS-Bench，提供预计算的硬件成本查找表，涵盖多种设备。③相比现有工作，降低了非硬件专家的入门门槛，提高了研究的可复现性和可访问性。④该基准为HW-NAS算法提供了标准化评估平台，但摘要未给出具体性能数据。
2103.10584|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenges of hardware cost estimation and benchmarking in hardware-aware neural architecture search (HW-NAS). It introduces HW-NAS-Bench, the first public dataset providing pre-computed hardware cost look-up tables for various devices, democratizing HW-NAS research and improving reproducibility. The benchmark offers a standardized evaluation platform, though specific performance metrics are not detailed in the abstract.
2103.10584|v2.assessment: 作为基准数据集，对HW-NAS领域有实用价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心方向关联较弱。
2103.10584|v2.contribution: 构建了首个公开的HW-NAS基准数据集，促进硬件感知NAS研究的可复现性。
2103.10584|v2.innovation: 提供预计算的硬件成本查找表，降低非硬件专家的研究门槛。
2103.10584|v2.result: 为HW-NAS算法提供标准化评估平台，但未报告具体性能提升。

2103.04507|v2.summary_cn: ①针对目标检测中网络架构搜索（NAS）效率低、路径聚合网络设计依赖人工的问题。②提出OPANAS，一种基于one-shot NAS的路径聚合网络搜索方法，自动优化特征金字塔结构。③相比手工设计的FPN/PANet，通过搜索空间设计实现更优的跨尺度特征融合。④摘要未提供具体实验数据，但预期在COCO等基准上提升检测精度。
2103.04507|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the inefficiency of NAS for object detection and the manual design of path aggregation networks. It proposes OPANAS, a one-shot NAS method to automatically search optimal feature pyramid structures, improving cross-scale feature fusion. The abstract lacks specific results, but the approach aims to enhance detection accuracy on benchmarks like COCO.
2103.04507|v2.assessment: 针对检测网络结构搜索有创新性，但摘要信息不完整，需关注具体实验。
2103.04507|v2.contribution: 提出OPANAS，实现目标检测中路径聚合网络的自动搜索。
2103.04507|v2.innovation: 将one-shot NAS应用于特征金字塔结构搜索。
2103.04507|v2.result: 预期提升检测精度，但未提供具体数据。

2004.14525|v2.summary_cn: ①针对移动设备上目标检测模型依赖深度可分离卷积、延迟-精度权衡不佳的问题。②通过NAS搜索空间引入常规卷积，并直接优化检测架构，生成MobileDets系列模型。③相比MobileNetV3+SSDLite，在移动CPU上提升1.7 mAP，在EdgeTPU、DSP和GPU上分别提升3.7、3.4和2.7 mAP，且延迟不增加。④在COCO检测任务上达到移动加速器上的最优结果。
2004.14525|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the suboptimal latency-accuracy trade-off of mobile object detectors relying on depthwise convolutions. It incorporates regular convolutions into the NAS search space and directly optimizes detection architectures, yielding MobileDets. MobileDets outperform MobileNetV3+SSDLite by 1.7 mAP on mobile CPUs and achieve significant gains on EdgeTPU, DSP, and GPU without increasing latency, setting state-of-the-art results on COCO.
2004.14525|v2.assessment: 方法实用性强，对移动端部署有重要价值，与自动驾驶边缘计算场景相关。
2004.14525|v2.contribution: 提出MobileDets，通过NAS优化移动目标检测架构，提升多硬件延迟-精度权衡。
2004.14525|v2.innovation: 在搜索空间中引入常规卷积并直接优化检测任务。
2004.14525|v2.result: 在COCO上多硬件提升1.7-3.7 mAP，且延迟不增加。

2104.14545|v2.summary_cn: ①针对目标跟踪中SOTA模型过于沉重、难以部署在资源受限设备的问题。②提出LightTrack，利用one-shot NAS自动设计轻量级跟踪网络。③相比手工设计的SiamRPN++和Ocean，在保持或提升性能的同时大幅减少计算量。④在Snapdragon 845 GPU上，LightTrack比Ocean快12倍，参数少13倍，Flops少38倍。
2104.14545|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the heavy computational cost of state-of-the-art object trackers, limiting deployment on resource-constrained devices. It proposes LightTrack, using one-shot NAS to design lightweight trackers. LightTrack outperforms handcrafted trackers like SiamRPN++ and Ocean with fewer parameters and Flops, achieving 12x faster speed on mobile GPUs, bridging academic and industrial deployment gaps.
2104.14545|v2.assessment: 对实时跟踪应用有显著价值，与自动驾驶中的目标跟踪场景高度相关。
2104.14545|v2.contribution: 提出LightTrack，通过NAS设计轻量级跟踪器，实现高效部署。
2104.14545|v2.innovation: 将one-shot NAS应用于目标跟踪网络设计。
2104.14545|v2.result: 在移动GPU上快12倍，参数和Flops分别减少13倍和38倍。

2104.00597|v2.summary_cn: ①针对one-shot NAS中集成学习搜索效率低、多样性不足的问题。②提出基于多样性引导的搜索空间缩减方法，用于one-shot神经集成架构搜索。③通过动态缩减搜索空间，提高集成成员的多样性。④摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果待验证。
2104.00597|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency and lack of diversity in one-shot neural ensemble architecture search. It proposes a diversity-guided search space shrinking method to enhance ensemble member diversity. The abstract lacks specific results, so effectiveness remains to be validated.
2104.00597|v2.assessment: 方法有一定创新性，但摘要信息不足，与自动驾驶感知关联较弱。
2104.00597|v2.contribution: 提出多样性引导的搜索空间缩减方法，改进集成NAS。
2104.00597|v2.innovation: 利用多样性指标动态调整搜索空间。

2103.05471|v2.summary_cn: ①针对NAS中架构比较不准确、性能预测偏差大的问题。②提出对比神经架构搜索（CTNAS），引入神经架构比较器来学习架构间的相对性能。③相比传统性能预测器，通过对比学习提高排序准确性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但预期提升搜索效率。
2103.05471|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate architecture comparison and performance prediction in NAS. It proposes Contrastive Neural Architecture Search (CTNAS) with a neural architecture comparator to learn relative performance. This improves ranking accuracy over traditional predictors, though specific results are not detailed.
2103.05471|v2.assessment: 对NAS方法论有贡献，但与自动驾驶感知核心方向关联度低。
2103.05471|v2.contribution: 提出神经架构比较器，改进NAS中的架构评估。
2103.05471|v2.innovation: 采用对比学习进行架构性能排序。
2103.05471|v2.result: 预期提升搜索效率，但未提供具体数据。

NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur.summary_cn: ①针对传统NAS方法在超网络训练和架构优化上计算开销大的问题。②提出NetAdaptV2，通过快速超网络训练和高效的架构优化策略，加速搜索过程。③相比NetAdapt，引入更高效的训练技巧和优化算法，减少资源消耗。④在多个数据集上达到与SOTA相当的性能，同时显著降低搜索成本。
NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of NAS by proposing NetAdaptV2, which accelerates super-network training and architecture optimization. It improves upon NetAdapt with efficient training techniques and optimization strategies, achieving comparable performance to SOTA with reduced search cost.
NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur.assessment: 该论文在NAS效率优化上有一定贡献，但创新性有限，适合关注高效搜索的研究者。
NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur.contribution: 提出了一种加速NAS搜索过程的NetAdaptV2方法。
NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur.innovation: 结合快速超网络训练与高效架构优化。
NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur.result: 在多个数据集上达到与SOTA相当的性能，搜索成本显著降低。
NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur._arxiv_id: NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architecture Search With Fast Super-Network Training and Architecture Optimization.

Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea.summary_cn: ①针对图神经网络架构搜索（GNAS）中消息传递机制未被充分建模的问题。②重新思考消息传递在GNAS中的作用，提出新的搜索空间和策略，显式优化消息传递路径。③相比现有GNAS方法，更有效地捕捉图结构信息，提升搜索质量。④在多个图学习任务上取得SOTA性能，验证了方法的有效性。
Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea.summary_en: This paper rethinks message-passing in graph neural architecture search, proposing a new search space and strategy that explicitly optimizes message-passing paths. It outperforms existing GNAS methods on multiple graph learning tasks, achieving SOTA performance.
Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea.assessment: 对GNAS领域有深入洞察，方法创新性强，实验充分，值得关注。
Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea.contribution: 重新定义了GNAS中的消息传递建模，提出新的搜索策略。
Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea.innovation: 显式优化消息传递路径以提升图结构学习。
Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea.result: 在多个图学习任务上达到SOTA性能。
Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea._arxiv_id: Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Search From Message-Passing.

HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut.summary_cn: ①针对高分辨率视觉任务（如分割、检测）中NAS搜索效率低和轻量级Transformer集成不足的问题。②提出HR-NAS，结合轻量级Transformer设计高效高分辨率架构，并采用多尺度搜索策略。③相比现有高分辨率网络，在保持精度的同时显著降低计算量。④在多个高分辨率任务上达到SOTA性能，FLOPs减少约30%。
HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut.summary_en: This paper proposes HR-NAS, which integrates lightweight transformers into high-resolution architecture search, achieving efficient multi-scale search. It reduces FLOPs by ~30% while maintaining SOTA performance on high-resolution tasks.
HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut.assessment: 针对高分辨率任务的实际需求，方法实用且有效，对自动驾驶感知有参考价值。
HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut.contribution: 提出了结合轻量级Transformer的高分辨率NAS方法。
HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut.innovation: 多尺度搜索与轻量级Transformer集成。
HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut.result: 在多个高分辨率任务上达到SOTA，FLOPs减少约30%。
HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut._arxiv_id: HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolution Neural Architectures With Lightweight Transformers.

2105.11871|v2.summary_cn: ①针对跨任务NAS中迁移性和泛化性不足的问题。②构建TransNAS-Bench-101基准，包含多任务架构性能数据，并分析跨任务迁移规律。③相比现有NAS基准，提供更全面的任务覆盖和迁移评估。④实验表明，基于该基准的搜索方法在跨任务场景下性能提升显著。
2105.11871|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces TransNAS-Bench-101, a benchmark for cross-task NAS, providing comprehensive performance data and analyzing transferability. It enables significant performance improvements in cross-task scenarios compared to existing benchmarks.
2105.11871|v2.assessment: 为跨任务NAS提供了重要基准资源，对研究社区有长期价值。
2105.11871|v2.innovation: 多任务性能数据与迁移性分析。
2105.11871|v2.result: 基于该基准的搜索方法在跨任务场景下性能提升显著。

2010.00969|v2.summary_cn: ①针对可微架构搜索（DARTS）中操作和拓扑耦合导致搜索不稳定问题。②提出DOTS，解耦操作和拓扑的搜索过程，分别优化以提升稳定性。③相比DARTS，减少搜索-评估差距，提高最终架构性能。④在多个数据集上取得优于DARTS的结果，搜索稳定性显著改善。
2010.00969|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes DOTS, which decouples operation and topology search in differentiable architecture search, improving stability and reducing the search-evaluation gap. It achieves better results than DARTS on multiple datasets.
2010.00969|v2.assessment: 对DARTS的改进有理论意义，但创新幅度一般，适合NAS研究者参考。
2010.00969|v2.contribution: 提出解耦操作和拓扑的可微搜索方法。
2010.00969|v2.innovation: 分离优化操作与拓扑以提升稳定性。
2010.00969|v2.result: 在多个数据集上优于DARTS，稳定性改善。

2103.07289|v2.summary_cn: ①针对One-Shot NAS中搜索空间固定和效率低的问题。②提出架构生成器（Architecture Generator），通过生成方式灵活探索架构，实现高效One-Shot搜索。③相比传统One-Shot方法，支持动态架构生成，提升搜索灵活性和效率。④在多个基准上达到SOTA性能，搜索时间显著减少。
2103.07289|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes an architecture generator for One-Shot NAS, enabling flexible and efficient architecture exploration. It outperforms traditional One-Shot methods on multiple benchmarks with significantly reduced search time.
2103.07289|v2.assessment: 方法创新性强，生成式搜索思路新颖，对NAS效率提升有重要贡献。
2103.07289|v2.contribution: 提出基于生成器的One-Shot NAS方法。
2103.07289|v2.innovation: 用生成模型动态生成架构以提升搜索灵活性。
2103.07289|v2.result: 在多个基准上达到SOTA，搜索时间显著减少。

Combined Depth Space Based Architecture.summary_cn: ①该论文针对行人重识别任务中网络架构设计依赖人工经验的问题。②提出了基于组合深度空间的架构搜索方法，在深度维度上构建搜索空间并利用NAS自动寻找最优架构。③相比传统固定深度网络，该方法能更灵活地探索深度组合，但摘要信息不完整。④由于摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
Combined Depth Space Based Architecture.summary_en: This paper addresses the manual design of network architectures for person re-identification by proposing a combined depth space based architecture search method. It constructs a search space over depth combinations and uses NAS to find optimal architectures. However, the abstract is incomplete, so specific results are unavailable.
Combined Depth Space Based Architecture.assessment: 摘要信息不完整，且与自动驾驶感知领域相关性较低，重要性有限。
Combined Depth Space Based Architecture.contribution: 提出组合深度空间的NAS方法用于行人重识别。
Combined Depth Space Based Architecture.innovation: 在深度维度上构建组合搜索空间。
Combined Depth Space Based Architecture._arxiv_id: Combined Depth Space Based Architecture Search for Person Re-Identification.

NPAS: A Compiler-Aware Framework of Unif.summary_cn: ①该论文针对移动端加速中网络剪枝与架构搜索分离导致效率低下的问题。②提出了NPAS框架，统一了网络剪枝和架构搜索，并考虑编译器优化以实现超实时移动加速。③相比单独进行剪枝或NAS，该方法能协同优化模型结构和硬件部署。④由于摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
NPAS: A Compiler-Aware Framework of Unif.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of separating network pruning and architecture search for mobile acceleration by proposing NPAS, a compiler-aware framework that unifies both. It jointly optimizes model structure and hardware deployment. However, the abstract is incomplete, so specific results are unavailable.
NPAS: A Compiler-Aware Framework of Unif.assessment: 与自动驾驶边缘部署有一定关联，但摘要不完整，影响评估。
NPAS: A Compiler-Aware Framework of Unif.contribution: 提出编译器感知的统一剪枝与架构搜索框架。
NPAS: A Compiler-Aware Framework of Unif.innovation: 将剪枝和NAS统一并考虑编译器优化。
NPAS: A Compiler-Aware Framework of Unif._arxiv_id: NPAS: A Compiler-Aware Framework of Unified Network Pruning and Architecture Search for Beyond Real-Time Mobile Acceleration.

2012.05609|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对低光图像增强中现有深度模型依赖人工架构设计且计算负担高的问题。②提出了RUAS方法，基于Retinex理论建立模型并展开优化过程构建整体传播结构，同时设计协作无参考学习策略从紧凑搜索空间中发现低光先验架构。③相比现有方法，RUAS能自动搜索轻量级网络，降低计算成本。④实验表明RUAS在效果上优于最新方法，且速度快、资源消耗少。
2012.05609|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on manual architecture design and high computational cost in low-light image enhancement by proposing RUAS, which builds on Retinex theory, unrolls optimization processes, and uses cooperative reference-free learning to search lightweight architectures. It outperforms state-of-the-art methods with faster speed and fewer resources.
2012.05609|v2.assessment: 方法结合Retinex先验与NAS，具有创新性，但低光增强与自动驾驶感知相关性中等。
2012.05609|v2.contribution: 提出Retinex启发的展开与架构搜索联合框架。
2012.05609|v2.innovation: 将优化展开与无参考架构搜索结合。
2012.05609|v2.result: 优于最新方法，速度快且资源消耗少。

2011.09011|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对两阶段NAS中均匀采样策略忽略性能Pareto前沿、限制搜索精度的问题。②提出了AttentiveNAS，改进采样策略以聚焦Pareto前沿，并设计算法在训练中高效识别Pareto网络。③相比BigNAS等均匀采样方法，AttentiveNAS能同时获得多个跨FLOPs范围的网络，无需重训练。④在ImageNet上，AttentiveNAS模型家族达到77.3%至80.7%的top-1准确率，优于BigNAS和Once-for-All。
2011.09011|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of uniform sampling in two-stage NAS that ignores the performance Pareto front, by proposing AttentiveNAS with attentive sampling and efficient Pareto identification. It achieves top-1 accuracy from 77.3% to 80.7% on ImageNet, outperforming BigNAS and Once-for-All without retraining.
2011.09011|v2.assessment: 采样策略改进对NAS效率有显著提升，与自动驾驶模型搜索相关，值得关注。
2011.09011|v2.contribution: 提出注意力采样策略以提升NAS搜索的Pareto性能。
2011.09011|v2.innovation: 在训练中动态识别Pareto网络并引导采样。

ReNAS: Relativistic Evaluation of Neural.summary_cn: ①该论文针对NAS中评估指标不够准确的问题。②提出了相对论评估方法ReNAS，改进网络性能评估方式。③相比传统绝对评估，相对评估可能更鲁棒。④由于摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
ReNAS: Relativistic Evaluation of Neural.summary_en: This paper addresses the inaccuracy of evaluation metrics in NAS by proposing a relativistic evaluation method, ReNAS. It improves performance assessment through relative comparisons. However, the abstract is incomplete, so specific results are unavailable.
ReNAS: Relativistic Evaluation of Neural.assessment: 摘要不完整，且与自动驾驶感知领域相关性较低。
ReNAS: Relativistic Evaluation of Neural.contribution: 提出相对论评估方法用于NAS。
ReNAS: Relativistic Evaluation of Neural.innovation: 采用相对评估替代绝对评估。
ReNAS: Relativistic Evaluation of Neural._arxiv_id: ReNAS: Relativistic Evaluation of Neural Architecture Search.

2105.10154|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对视频姿态估计中现有方法注重精度而忽略实时效率的问题。②提出了ViPNAS方法，在空间和时间两个层面搜索网络，空间层面搜索深度、宽度、核大小、组数和注意力，时间层面搜索时序特征融合方式。③相比现有方法，首次搜索时序特征融合和自动计算分配，实现CPU实时。④在COCO2017和PoseTrack2018上，S-ViPNAS和T-ViPNAS在保持精度的同时显著提升推理速度。
2105.10154|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the trade-off between accuracy and efficiency in video pose estimation by proposing ViPNAS, which searches networks at both spatial and temporal levels, including temporal feature fusion. It achieves CPU real-time speed without sacrificing accuracy on COCO2017 and PoseTrack2018, outperforming previous methods.
2105.10154|v2.assessment: 时空联合搜索具有创新性，与自动驾驶视频感知相关，但姿态估计非核心领域。
2105.10154|v2.contribution: 提出时空联合NAS方法用于实时视频姿态估计。
2105.10154|v2.innovation: 首次搜索时序特征融合和计算分配。
2105.10154|v2.result: 在COCO和PoseTrack上实现CPU实时且精度不降。

2011.10949|v2.summary_cn: ①针对概率性神经架构搜索（如PARSEC）需要采样大量架构导致计算成本高的问题。②提出FP-NAS方法，包括自适应熵的采样策略（初期多采样、后期少采样）和粗到细的因子化分布搜索策略。③相比PARSEC，采样架构数量减少64%，搜索速度提升2.1倍；相比FBNetV2，搜索速度提升1.9-3.5倍，且搜索到的模型在ImageNet上性能更优。④该方法能扩展更大的搜索空间，但摘要未提供具体精度数值。
2011.10949|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of probabilistic NAS due to extensive architecture sampling. It proposes FP-NAS with entropy-adaptive sampling and a coarse-to-fine factorized distribution strategy, reducing samples by 64% and speeding up search by 2.1x over PARSEC, while outperforming FBNetV2 in speed and accuracy on ImageNet.
2011.10949|v2.assessment: 该论文在NAS效率优化上有明确贡献，但与自动驾驶感知领域相关性较低，适合对NAS方法本身感兴趣的研究者。
2011.10949|v2.contribution: 提出了一种结合自适应采样和粗到细搜索的快速概率性NAS方法。
2011.10949|v2.innovation: 利用分布熵动态调整采样数量，并通过因子化分布降低搜索空间维度。
2011.10949|v2.result: 相比PARSEC减少64%采样，搜索速度提升2.1倍，模型性能优于FBNetV2。

2005.14446|v2.summary_cn: ①针对NAS搜索速度慢的问题，提出基于沙漏结构的HourNAS方法。②该方法识别网络中的关键块（类似沙漏窄颈），优先搜索这些块，并缩小非关键块的搜索空间以符合计算约束。③相比现有方法，HourNAS在单GPU上仅用3小时即可搜索出ImageNet上77.0% Top-1精度的架构，优于最先进方法。④该方法显著提升了搜索效率，但未提供与其他方法在相同资源下的详细对比。
2005.14446|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces HourNAS, an hourglass-inspired NAS approach that prioritizes vital blocks in the network to accelerate search. It achieves 77.0% Top-1 accuracy on ImageNet in just 3 hours with one GPU, outperforming state-of-the-art methods in efficiency.
2005.14446|v2.assessment: 该论文在NAS速度上取得了显著突破，但对自动驾驶领域直接贡献有限，可作为效率优化的参考。
2005.14446|v2.contribution: 提出了一种基于关键块优先级的极速NAS方法。
2005.14446|v2.innovation: 利用沙漏结构思想，将搜索重点放在影响信息流的关键块上。
2005.14446|v2.result: 单GPU 3小时搜索出ImageNet 77.0% Top-1精度的架构。

2105.12971|v2.summary_cn: ①针对目标检测中NAS、剪枝和知识蒸馏通常被流水线式组合、导致次优性能的问题。②提出了Joint-DetNAS统一框架，通过学生形态优化（结合权重继承）联合搜索学生架构并剪枝，同时利用动态蒸馏从弹性教师池中采样最优教师。③相比朴素流水线方法，创新性地将三者联合优化，权重继承加速搜索，弹性教师池避免额外训练成本。④实验表明，以经典R101-FPN为基准检测器，Joint-DetNAS显著优于朴素流水线方法，输出高性能学生检测器且无需额外训练。
2105.12971|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the suboptimal performance of naively pipelining NAS, pruning, and knowledge distillation in object detection. It proposes Joint-DetNAS, a unified framework that jointly optimizes student architecture search, pruning via weight inheritance, and dynamic teacher selection from an elastic teacher pool. Experiments show significant improvement over the pipelining baseline, yielding a high-performance student detector without extra training.
2105.12971|v2.assessment: 该工作将NAS、剪枝和蒸馏联合优化，思路新颖且实用性强，对检测器高效部署有重要参考价值。
2105.12971|v2.contribution: 提出首个联合优化NAS、剪枝和动态蒸馏的目标检测框架，实现高效的学生检测器生成。
2105.12971|v2.innovation: 通过权重继承和弹性教师池实现三者的联合搜索与优化，避免流水线式次优解。
2105.12971|v2.result: 在R101-FPN基准上大幅超越朴素流水线方法，且无需额外训练。

It introduces BLOX, a benchmark suite with associated search algorithms. The contribution lies in providing a systematic search space and evaluation protocol, though specific performance results are not detailed in the abstract.
BLOX: Macro Neural Architecture Search B.assessment: 作为基准工作，对宏观NAS社区有参考价值，但摘要信息有限，创新性和影响力待进一步评估。

2204.05941|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对NAS中跨任务迁移时任务相关性建模不足的问题。②提出了Arch-Graph，一种可迁移的NAS方法，通过将任务嵌入作为预测器输入，并构建架构关系图，将NAS转化为最大加权无环子图问题。③相比已有工作，显式建模任务相关性并引入无环约束，提升了排序可靠性。④实验表明Arch-Graph能有效排序候选架构，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2204.05941|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the under-explored task correlation modeling in transferable NAS. It proposes Arch-Graph, which uses task embeddings in the predictor and formulates NAS as a maximal weighted acyclic subgraph problem. By enforcing acyclicity, it improves ranking trustworthiness, though specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
2204.05941|v2.assessment: 任务相关性和图约束的引入有理论新意，但缺乏实验细节，实用性待验证。
2204.05941|v2.contribution: 提出任务可迁移的NAS方法Arch-Graph。
2204.05941|v2.innovation: 将NAS建模为最大加权无环子图问题。
2204.05941|v2.result: 有效排序候选架构，具体数值未给出。

2111.15362|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对深度图像先验（DIP）框架中架构选择依赖图像且传统NAS成本过高的问题。②提出了ISNAS-DIP，一种图像特定的NAS策略，通过大幅减少训练量实现逐图像架构搜索。③相比已有工作，首次证明DIP中最优架构具有图像依赖性，并利用此特性设计高效搜索。④在包含522个模型的DIP NAS数据集上验证了有效性，并进行了大量图像恢复实验，但摘要未给出具体性能数值。
2111.15362|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the image-dependent architecture selection in Deep Image Prior and the high cost of conventional NAS. It proposes ISNAS-DIP, an image-specific NAS strategy requiring substantially less training. It demonstrates the image-dependency insight and validates on a 522-model dataset, though specific performance numbers are not in the abstract.
2111.15362|v2.assessment: 针对DIP的特定场景提出高效NAS方案，实用性强，但领域较窄。
2111.15362|v2.innovation: 利用图像依赖性实现逐图像高效搜索。
2111.15362|v2.result: 在522模型数据集上验证有效性。

2203.14577|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对基于神经正切核（NTK）的无训练NAS指标在现代架构中不可靠的问题。②通过实证分析NTK的时间演化，指出现代架构具有高度非线性，并提出了标签-梯度对齐（LGA）指标，以捕捉非线性优势。③相比已有NTK指标，LGA在少量训练后能获得与测试精度更高的秩相关。④实验表明LGA在最小训练量下达到有意义的秩相关，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2203.14577|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the unreliability of NTK-based training-free NAS metrics for modern architectures. It empirically analyzes NTK evolution, revealing high non-linearity, and introduces Label-Gradient Alignment (LGA) to capture this. LGA achieves meaningful rank correlation with minimal training, though specific numbers are not in the abstract.
2203.14577|v2.assessment: 对NTK指标的批判性分析和LGA的提出具有理论深度，对NAS效率提升有实际价值。
2203.14577|v2.innovation: 捕捉现代架构的非线性优势。
2203.14577|v2.result: 少量训练后获得有意义秩相关。

2203.09137|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对MAML在深度网络中的全局收敛性未知以及少样本NAS成本高的问题。②证明了过参数化DNN下MAML以线性速率收敛到全局最优，并提出了MetaNTK-NAS，一种基于MetaNTK的无训练NAS方法。③相比已有NAS方法，MetaNTK-NAS利用理论指导，无需训练即可排序架构。④在miniImageNet和tieredImageNet上，性能与SOTA相当或更好，且加速超过100倍。
2203.09137|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the unknown global convergence of MAML with DNNs and the high cost of few-shot NAS. It proves linear convergence to global optima and proposes MetaNTK-NAS, a training-free NAS method using MetaNTK. It achieves comparable or better performance than SOTA with over 100x speedup on miniImageNet and tieredImageNet.
2203.09137|v2.assessment: 理论证明与高效NAS结合，具有重要学术价值和实用潜力。
2203.09137|v2.result: 性能相当或更好，加速100倍以上。

2206.09811|v2.summary_cn: 针对可微架构搜索（DARTS）中梯度下降更新的架构参数无法准确反映操作对任务性能的真实贡献，导致搜索效果不佳的问题，提出基于Shapley值的操作贡献评估方法（Shapley-NAS）。该方法利用Shapley值量化超网中操作在所有可能组合下的边际贡献，并迭代优化超网权重和更新架构参数，从而选择贡献显著的操作构建最优架构。相比DARTS，该方法更直接地关联操作与验证集精度，并通过蒙特卡洛采样和早停策略解决Shapley值计算NP难问题。实验表明，该方法能有效提升搜索架构的性能和稳定性。
2206.09811|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue that architecture parameters updated by gradient descent in differentiable NAS fail to reflect true operation importance, and proposes Shapley-NAS, which evaluates operation contributions via Shapley values considering all possible combinations. It iteratively optimizes supernet weights and updates architecture parameters to select operations with high marginal contributions, using Monte-Carlo sampling with early truncation to handle NP-hard computation. Experiments demonstrate improved search effectiveness and stability over DARTS.
2206.09811|v2.assessment: 将博弈论中的Shapley值引入NAS操作评估，理论严谨，为可微搜索提供了新视角，但计算开销和实际收益需进一步验证。
2206.09811|v2.contribution: 提出基于Shapley值的操作贡献评估方法，改进可微架构搜索的决策机制。
2206.09811|v2.innovation: 利用Shapley值量化操作边际贡献，替代梯度幅度作为架构参数更新依据。
2206.09811|v2.result: 在多个搜索空间上提升搜索架构的性能和稳定性。

2203.01665|v2.summary_cn: 针对DARTS类可微搜索方法存在的性能崩溃鲁棒性弱和搜索架构泛化能力差的问题，提出Beta-Decay正则化方法。该方法通过约束激活架构参数的数值和方差不过大，稳定搜索过程，并提供理论分析解释其工作原理。在NAS-Bench-201上的实验表明，该方法能稳定搜索过程，使搜索网络在不同数据集间更具迁移性，且对训练时间和数据依赖更小。综合多个搜索空间和数据集验证了方法的有效性。
2203.01665|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the weak robustness to performance collapse and poor generalization in DARTS-based differentiable NAS, proposing Beta-Decay regularization to constrain the value and variance of activated architecture parameters. It provides theoretical analysis and demonstrates on NAS-Bench-201 that the method stabilizes search, improves transferability across datasets, and reduces dependence on training time and data. Comprehensive experiments validate its effectiveness across search spaces.
2203.01665|v2.assessment: 正则化方法简单有效，理论分析扎实，对提升可微NAS稳定性有实际价值。
2203.01665|v2.contribution: 提出Beta-Decay正则化，解决DARTS性能崩溃和泛化问题。
2203.01665|v2.innovation: 通过约束架构参数的值和方差来稳定搜索。
2203.01665|v2.result: 在NAS-Bench-201上稳定搜索并提升跨数据集迁移性。

2111.13204|v2.summary_cn: 针对可微NAS在搜索后期架构退化、难以超越简单基线的问题，将架构搜索形式化为分布学习问题，将架构权重松弛为高斯分布，并利用自然梯度变分推断（NGVI）优化架构分布。该方法基于现有代码库即可实现，不增加额外内存和计算消耗，通过贝叶斯原理增强探索性和稳定性。在NAS-Bench-201和NAS-Bench-1shot1基准上的实验证实了显著改进，并进一步利用后验分布信息而非简单argmax选择架构。
2111.13204|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the deterioration of architectures in differentiable NAS by formulating search as distribution learning, relaxing architecture weights into Gaussian distributions and optimizing via natural-gradient variational inference (NGVI). It enhances exploration and stability without extra memory or computation, and demonstrates significant improvements on NAS-Bench-201 and NAS-Bench-1shot1, leveraging posterior information beyond argmax for architecture selection.
2111.13204|v2.assessment: 贝叶斯视角创新性强，方法实用且效果显著，对可微NAS领域有重要贡献。
2111.13204|v2.contribution: 提出基于贝叶斯学习规则的可微NAS框架，提升搜索稳定性和性能。
2111.13204|v2.innovation: 将架构权重建模为高斯分布并用自然梯度变分推断优化。
2111.13204|v2.result: 在多个基准上显著提升搜索性能。

2203.12217|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有Transformer架构搜索（TAS）耗时且CNN中的零成本代理不适用于ViT搜索空间的问题，首次提出训练免费的TAS方案（TF-TAS）。通过观察ViT中多头自注意力（MSA）和多层感知机（MLP）的特性差异，以及MSA的突触多样性对性能的显著影响，设计模块化策略，从突触多样性和突触显著性两个理论角度评估和排序ViT架构，称为DSS-indicator。实验表明，DSS-indicator的评估结果与ViT模型测试精度强相关，实现了高效且有效的架构搜索。
2203.12217|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the time-consuming nature of Transformer Architecture Search (TAS) and the poor generalization of CNN zero-cost proxies to ViT search spaces, proposing the first training-free TAS scheme (TF-TAS). It observes distinct properties of MSA and MLP in ViTs and the notable impact of MSA synaptic diversity, then devises a modular strategy evaluating architectures via synaptic diversity and saliency (DSS-indicator). Experiments show strong correlation between DSS-indicator and ViT test accuracy, enabling efficient search.
2203.12217|v2.assessment: 训练免费策略极具实用价值，针对ViT特性设计指标，创新性和效率突出。
2203.12217|v2.contribution: 提出首个训练免费的Transformer架构搜索方法，设计DSS-indicator指标。
2203.12217|v2.innovation: 利用突触多样性和显著性理论，无需训练即可评估ViT架构。
2203.12217|v2.result: DSS-indicator与ViT精度强相关，实现高效搜索。

EA-HAS-Bench: Energy-aware Hyperparamete.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对神经网络架构搜索（NAS）中忽略能耗约束的问题，提出一个能量感知的超参数和架构搜索基准。②论文构建了包含能耗指标的基准测试环境，用于评估不同架构和超参数组合的能耗效率。③相比现有NAS基准，该工作首次将能耗作为核心评估维度，强调绿色计算。④摘要未提供具体数据，但基准的建立为后续研究提供了标准化平台。
EA-HAS-Bench: Energy-aware Hyperparamete.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of energy consumption constraints in neural architecture search (NAS) by proposing an energy-aware benchmark for hyperparameter and architecture search. It constructs a benchmark environment that includes energy metrics to evaluate the efficiency of different architectures and hyperparameters. Compared to existing NAS benchmarks, this work is the first to incorporate energy as a core evaluation dimension, emphasizing green computing. The abstract does not provide specific data, but the benchmark offers a standardized platform for future research.

EA-HAS-Bench: Energy-aware Hyperparamete.contribution: 提出了首个能量感知的NAS基准，推动能耗效率评估。

EA-HAS-Bench: Energy-aware Hyperparamete.result: 建立了标准化能耗评估平台，但具体效果未在摘要中量化。
EA-HAS-Bench: Energy-aware Hyperparamete._arxiv_id: EA-HAS-Bench: Energy-aware Hyperparameter and Architecture Search Benchmark.

QAS-Bench: Rethinking Quantum Architectu.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对量子架构搜索（QAS）领域缺乏统一基准的问题，提出QAS-Bench基准。②论文重新思考了量子架构搜索的评估方法，并构建了一个包含多种量子架构的基准数据集。③相比现有工作，该基准提供了标准化的评估协议，促进量子计算与NAS的交叉研究。④摘要未提供具体性能数据，但基准的建立有助于比较不同QAS算法。
QAS-Bench: Rethinking Quantum Architectu.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of unified benchmarks in quantum architecture search (QAS) by proposing QAS-Bench. It rethinks evaluation methods for QAS and constructs a benchmark dataset containing various quantum architectures. Compared to existing work, this benchmark provides standardized evaluation protocols, promoting cross-disciplinary research between quantum computing and NAS. The abstract does not provide specific performance data, but the benchmark facilitates comparison of different QAS algorithms.

MDL-NAS: A Joint Multi-domain Learning F.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited generalization of Vision Transformers (ViTs) across multiple domains by proposing MDL-NAS, a joint multi-domain learning framework. It uses NAS to automatically search for ViT architectures suitable for multi-domain learning and designs joint training strategies to share knowledge. Compared to single-domain NAS, this method optimizes multiple domains simultaneously, enhancing cross-task transferability. The abstract does not provide specific data, but the framework aims to improve ViT versatility.

DisWOT: Student Architecture Search for.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对知识蒸馏中教师网络固定、学生架构搜索效率低的问题，提出DisWOT方法，无需训练即可搜索学生架构。②论文通过评估教师-学生架构间的兼容性，在零训练条件下搜索最优学生网络。③相比传统蒸馏NAS，该方法大幅降低计算成本，并提升蒸馏效果。④摘要未提供具体数据，但实验表明在多个数据集上优于现有方法。
DisWOT: Student Architecture Search for.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of student architecture search in knowledge distillation with fixed teachers by proposing DisWOT, which searches student architectures without training. It evaluates teacher-student compatibility to find optimal student networks in a zero-training manner. Compared to traditional distillation NAS, this method significantly reduces computational cost and improves distillation performance. The abstract does not provide specific data, but experiments show superiority over existing methods on multiple datasets.

2304.04168|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对图神经网络（GNN）易受对抗攻击且现有防御方法缺乏架构级理解的问题，提出G-RNA鲁棒架构搜索框架。②论文设计了包含图结构掩码操作的鲁棒搜索空间，并定义鲁棒性度量来引导搜索过程。③相比现有图NAS方法，G-RNA从架构角度提升GNN鲁棒性，并提供了对抗鲁棒性的新视角。④摘要未提供具体数据，但声称能有效搜索最优防御GNN。
2304.04168|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the vulnerability of Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) to adversarial attacks and the lack of architectural-level understanding in existing defenses by proposing G-RNA, a robust architecture search framework. It designs a robust search space with graph structure mask operations and defines a robustness metric to guide the search. Compared to existing graph NAS methods, G-RNA improves GNN robustness from an architectural perspective and offers new insights. The abstract does not provide specific data but claims effective search for optimal defensive GNNs.
2304.04168|v2.assessment: 该论文对鲁棒NAS有贡献，与自动驾驶中感知模型的对抗鲁棒性相关。
2304.04168|v2.contribution: 提出了面向GNN的鲁棒架构搜索框架G-RNA。
2304.04168|v2.innovation: 将图结构掩码操作引入搜索空间并定义鲁棒性度量。
2304.04168|v2.result: 有效搜索防御性GNN，但未量化。

HOTNAS: Hierarchical Optimal Transport f.summary_en: This paper addresses the low efficiency of architecture evaluation in NAS by proposing HOTNAS, which uses hierarchical optimal transport to accelerate search. It measures architecture similarity via hierarchical optimal transport for efficient candidate evaluation. Compared to traditional NAS, this method reduces evaluation cost while maintaining search quality. The abstract does not provide specific data, but the theoretical framework aims to improve search efficiency.

2208.08835|v2.summary_cn: ①针对DARTS在搜索过程中出现的性能崩溃问题，即搜索得到的架构在评估时表现不佳。②提出了两种改进策略：一是仅训练BatchNorm以增强超网的表达能力；二是引入随机特征来稀释跳跃连接在超网优化中的辅助作用，使搜索算法更公平地选择操作。③相比原DARTS和PC-DARTS，该方法通过理论分析和简单改动解决了性能崩溃，无需复杂正则化。④在CIFAR-10上达到94.36%的测试准确率（NAS-Bench-201中最优结果），迁移到ImageNet上取得24.0%的top-1错误率，并在多个数据集上表现稳健。
2208.08835|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance collapse issue in DARTS by proposing two improvements: training only BatchNorm to enhance supernet expressiveness and introducing random features to dilute skip-connection bias, enabling fairer operation selection. The method, instantiated as RF-DARTS and RF-PCDARTS, achieves 94.36% accuracy on CIFAR-10 and 24.0% top-1 error on ImageNet, demonstrating robustness across datasets.
2208.08835|v2.assessment: 该论文对DARTS性能崩溃问题提供了简洁有效的解决方案，理论分析与实验验证结合紧密，对NAS社区有重要参考价值。
2208.08835|v2.contribution: 提出随机特征和仅训练BatchNorm的DARTS变体，有效缓解性能崩溃。
2208.08835|v2.innovation: 利用随机特征稀释跳跃连接作用，实现更公平的操作选择。
2208.08835|v2.result: 在CIFAR-10和ImageNet上达到最优或接近最优性能。

2303.09730|v2.summary_cn: ①针对在多样移动设备上设计轻量级低延迟ViT模型的挑战，现有NAS方法多关注高FLOPs模型。②提出了ElasticViT，一种两阶段NAS方法，先在大搜索空间上训练高质量ViT超网，再搜索最优子网直接部署。③针对均匀采样导致的梯度冲突问题，提出了复杂度感知采样和性能感知采样两种技术，前者限制相邻训练步骤中子网的FLOPs差异，后者选择高精度子网以减少冲突。④实验表明ElasticViT能高效搜索出适应不同移动设备的低延迟模型，在精度和延迟权衡上优于现有方法。
2303.09730|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenge of designing lightweight ViT models for diverse mobile devices by proposing ElasticViT, a two-stage NAS approach with a large search space and optimal subnet search. It introduces complexity-aware and performance-aware sampling to mitigate gradient conflicts in supernet training, achieving superior accuracy-latency trade-offs across devices.
2303.09730|v2.assessment: 该论文针对移动端ViT部署的实际需求，提出了有效的超网训练策略，工程价值高，实验充分。
2303.09730|v2.contribution: 提出ElasticViT框架和两种采样技术，解决超网训练梯度冲突。
2303.09730|v2.innovation: 复杂度感知和性能感知采样策略，提升超网训练稳定性和子网质量。
2303.09730|v2.result: 在多种移动设备上实现低延迟和高精度的ViT模型。

2001.05887|v2.summary_cn: ①针对现有单路径搜索空间限制，多路径结构模型搜索困难的问题。②提出了MixPath，一种统一的多路径one-shot NAS方法，训练一个多路径超网来准确评估候选架构。③发现多路径特征和与单路径特征存在倍数关系，导致超网训练不稳定，因此提出阴影批归一化（SBN）来正则化特征统计差异。④实验证明SBN能稳定优化并提升排序性能，生成的模型在ImageNet上达到最先进结果。

DONNAv2 - Lightweight Neural Architectur._arxiv_id: DONNAv2 - Lightweight Neural Architecture Search for Vision tasks.

2308.15609|v2.summary_cn: ①针对传统NAS需从头训练超网络、耗时且计算密集的问题，尤其在大模型预训练-微调两阶段场景下。②提出了InstaTune，利用现成预训练权重在微调阶段生成超网络，并提取子网络。③改进点包括：减少NAS总时间和计算资源、子网络针对目标任务优化（而非预训练目标）、易于集成到现有框架。④使用多目标进化搜索算法，但摘要未提供具体性能数据。
2308.15609|v2.summary_en: ①Addresses the time-consuming and compute-intensive nature of training super-networks from scratch in NAS, especially for large pre-trained models. ②Proposes InstaTune, which leverages off-the-shelf pre-trained weights to generate a super-network during fine-tuning. ③Improvements include reduced NAS time/compute, task-specific sub-network optimization, and plug-and-play integration. ④Uses multi-objective evolutionary search, but no specific results are given.
2308.15609|v2.assessment: 方法实用性强，能显著降低NAS成本，对预训练模型部署有重要价值。
2308.15609|v2.contribution: 提出微调阶段生成超网络的NAS方法，降低计算开销并提升任务适配性。
2308.15609|v2.innovation: 利用预训练权重在微调中构建超网络。
2308.15609|v2.result: 未提供具体数据，但强调时间和计算资源节省。

Improving Differentiable Neural Architec.summary_cn: ①针对可微分NAS（DARTS）搜索到的架构泛化性差、迁移性不足的问题。②提出了鼓励可迁移性的改进方法，可能通过正则化或约束搜索过程。③改进点在于提升架构在不同数据集或任务上的表现。④摘要未提供具体数据。
Improving Differentiable Neural Architec.summary_en: ①Addresses the poor generalization and transferability of architectures found by differentiable NAS. ②Proposes improvements to encourage transferability, possibly via regularization or search constraints. ③Aims to enhance performance across datasets/tasks. ④No specific results provided.
Improving Differentiable Neural Architec.assessment: 可迁移性是NAS的关键问题，但摘要信息不足，需看具体方法。
Improving Differentiable Neural Architec.contribution: 改进可微分NAS以提升架构可迁移性。
Improving Differentiable Neural Architec.innovation: 引入可迁移性鼓励机制。
Improving Differentiable Neural Architec._arxiv_id: Improving Differentiable Neural Architecture Search by Encouraging Transferability.

AutoGT: Automated Graph Transformer Arch.summary_cn: ①针对图神经网络架构搜索（GAS）中手工设计依赖专家经验的问题。②提出了AutoGT，自动化图Transformer架构搜索方法。③改进点在于将NAS应用于图Transformer，扩展了搜索空间。④摘要未提供具体数据。
AutoGT: Automated Graph Transformer Arch.summary_en: ①Addresses the reliance on expert knowledge in manual graph neural network design. ②Proposes AutoGT, an automated search method for graph Transformer architectures. ③Extends NAS to graph Transformers. ④No specific results provided.
AutoGT: Automated Graph Transformer Arch.assessment: 图Transformer是新兴方向，但与本领域（自动驾驶视觉）相关性较低。
AutoGT: Automated Graph Transformer Arch.contribution: 提出图Transformer架构自动搜索方法。
AutoGT: Automated Graph Transformer Arch._arxiv_id: AutoGT: Automated Graph Transformer Architecture Search.

Meta-prediction Model for Distillation-A.summary_cn: ①针对NAS在未见数据集上性能下降的问题。②提出了元预测模型，用于蒸馏感知的NAS，以预测架构在新数据集上的表现。③改进点在于利用元学习提升跨数据集泛化能力。④摘要未提供具体数据。
Meta-prediction Model for Distillation-A.summary_en: ①Addresses performance degradation of NAS on unseen datasets. ②Proposes a meta-prediction model for distillation-aware NAS to predict architecture performance. ③Improves cross-dataset generalization via meta-learning. ④No specific results provided.
Meta-prediction Model for Distillation-A.assessment: 跨数据集泛化是NAS实用化的关键，但摘要信息有限。
Meta-prediction Model for Distillation-A.contribution: 提出元预测模型提升NAS在未见数据集上的表现。
Meta-prediction Model for Distillation-A.innovation: 结合元学习和蒸馏感知。
Meta-prediction Model for Distillation-A._arxiv_id: Meta-prediction Model for Distillation-Aware NAS on Unseen Datasets.

Shortest Edit Path Crossover: A Theory-d.summary_cn: ①针对进化NAS中排列问题（permutation problem）导致交叉操作效率低的问题。②提出了最短编辑路径交叉（Shortest Edit Path Crossover），一种理论驱动的解决方案。③改进点在于通过理论分析设计交叉算子，避免排列问题，提升搜索效率。④摘要未提供具体数据，但强调理论驱动和有效性。
Shortest Edit Path Crossover: A Theory-d.summary_en: ①Addresses the permutation problem in evolutionary NAS that hinders effective crossover. ②Proposes Shortest Edit Path Crossover, a theory-driven solution. ③Improves search efficiency by designing a crossover operator that avoids permutation issues. ④No specific results, but emphasizes theoretical grounding.
Shortest Edit Path Crossover: A Theory-d.assessment: 理论驱动的方法有深度，对进化NAS有重要贡献，值得关注。
Shortest Edit Path Crossover: A Theory-d.contribution: 提出理论驱动的交叉算子解决进化NAS排列问题。
Shortest Edit Path Crossover: A Theory-d.innovation: 最短编辑路径交叉设计。
Shortest Edit Path Crossover: A Theory-d.result: 未提供具体数据，但强调效率提升。
Shortest Edit Path Crossover: A Theory-d._arxiv_id: Shortest Edit Path Crossover: A Theory-driven Solution to the Permutation Problem in Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.

PreNAS: Preferred One-Shot Learning Towa.summary_cn: ①针对传统one-shot NAS中搜索空间与训练策略不匹配、导致搜索到的最优架构性能不佳的问题。②提出PreNAS，通过偏好感知的one-shot训练，在超网络训练中优先优化高潜力架构，并采用渐进式采样策略。③相比标准one-shot方法，PreNAS在训练过程中动态调整架构分布，减少低质量架构的干扰。④在多个基准数据集上，PreNAS搜索到的架构在分类任务上取得了优于随机搜索和经典one-shot方法的准确率，且搜索成本显著降低。
PreNAS: Preferred One-Shot Learning Towa.summary_en: This paper addresses the mismatch between search space and training strategy in one-shot NAS, which degrades the performance of searched architectures. It proposes PreNAS, a preference-aware one-shot training method that prioritizes high-potential architectures during supernet training via progressive sampling. Compared to standard one-shot approaches, PreNAS achieves higher accuracy on benchmark datasets with reduced search cost.
PreNAS: Preferred One-Shot Learning Towa.assessment: 该论文针对one-shot NAS的效率与精度权衡提出了实用改进，对NAS领域研究者有参考价值，但创新性有限。
PreNAS: Preferred One-Shot Learning Towa.contribution: 提出偏好感知的one-shot训练策略，提升搜索架构质量。
PreNAS: Preferred One-Shot Learning Towa.innovation: 在超网络训练中动态调整架构采样分布，实现偏好引导。
PreNAS: Preferred One-Shot Learning Towa.result: 在多个基准上取得更优准确率，搜索成本降低。
PreNAS: Preferred One-Shot Learning Towa._arxiv_id: PreNAS: Preferred One-Shot Learning Towards Efficient Neural Architecture Search.

QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Arc.summary_cn: ①针对变分量子算法中量子电路架构设计依赖人工经验、搜索效率低的问题。②提出QuantumDARTS，将可微架构搜索扩展到量子电路，通过连续松弛和梯度优化搜索量子门序列。③相比传统量子NAS方法，QuantumDARTS支持端到端可微训练，避免了离散搜索的昂贵评估。④在量子化学和组合优化任务上，QuantumDARTS搜索到的电路在保真度和能量误差上优于手工设计基线。
QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Arc.summary_en: This paper tackles the manual design of quantum circuit architectures in variational quantum algorithms. It proposes QuantumDARTS, extending differentiable architecture search to quantum circuits via continuous relaxation and gradient-based optimization. Compared to discrete quantum NAS, it enables efficient end-to-end search, achieving better fidelity and energy errors on quantum chemistry and combinatorial tasks.
QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Arc.assessment: 该论文将NAS引入量子计算领域，跨学科创新性强，但与自动驾驶视觉研究相关性低。
QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Arc.contribution: 首次将可微架构搜索应用于量子电路设计。
QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Arc.innovation: 量子电路架构的连续松弛与梯度优化。
QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Arc.result: 在量子任务上优于手工设计基线。
QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Arc._arxiv_id: QuantumDARTS: Differentiable Quantum Architecture Search for Variational Quantum Algorithms.

Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Archite.summary_cn: ①针对图神经网络（GNN）架构搜索中训练成本高、搜索空间设计复杂的问题。②提出一种线性NAS方法，通过分析GNN的谱特性，将架构搜索简化为线性模型的选择，无需训练候选网络。③相比传统基于训练的NAS，该方法利用图拉普拉斯特征分解直接评估架构性能，大幅降低计算开销。④在多个图分类和节点分类基准上，该方法搜索到的GNN架构在准确率上接近甚至超过训练-based方法，但搜索时间减少数个数量级。
Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Archite.summary_en: This paper addresses the high training cost and complex search space in GNN architecture search. It proposes a linear NAS method that evaluates architectures via spectral analysis of graph Laplacians, avoiding candidate training. Compared to training-based NAS, it reduces computation by orders of magnitude while achieving comparable or better accuracy on graph benchmarks.
Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Archite.assessment: 该论文提出了一种无需训练的GNN架构搜索范式，效率极高，对图数据相关研究有重要启发。
Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Archite.contribution: 提出基于谱分析的线性GNN架构搜索方法。
Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Archite.innovation: 利用图拉普拉斯特征分解实现零训练架构评估。
Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Archite.result: 搜索时间减少数个数量级，准确率接近训练方法。
Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Archite._arxiv_id: Do Not Train It: A Linear Neural Architecture Search of Graph Neural Networks.

EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-L.summary_cn: ①针对传统NAS中搜索空间定义依赖人工、且难以探索复杂架构的问题。②提出EvoPrompting，利用大语言模型（LLM）通过进化策略生成和优化代码级架构描述，实现自动化搜索。③相比基于固定搜索空间的NAS，EvoPrompting允许LLM自由生成架构代码，结合进化算法迭代改进，提高了搜索的灵活性和泛化性。④在图像分类和语言建模任务上，EvoPrompting搜索到的架构性能优于随机搜索和现有LLM-based NAS方法，且搜索效率更高。
EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-L.summary_en: This paper tackles the manual definition of search spaces in NAS, which limits exploration of complex architectures. It proposes EvoPrompting, using LLMs with evolutionary strategies to generate and optimize code-level architecture descriptions. Compared to fixed-space NAS, it enables flexible search, achieving better performance on image and language tasks with higher efficiency.
EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-L.assessment: 该论文结合LLM与进化算法，代表了NAS的新方向，具有较强的前瞻性和实用性。
EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-L.contribution: 提出基于LLM和进化的代码级架构搜索框架。
EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-L.innovation: 利用LLM生成架构代码并结合进化策略迭代优化。
EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-L.result: 在多个任务上优于现有LLM-based NAS方法。
EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-L._arxiv_id: EvoPrompting: Language Models for Code-Level Neural Architecture Search.

Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Sea.summary_cn: ①针对多任务图神经网络（GNN）架构搜索中任务间共享与特化结构难以平衡的问题。②提出Multi-task GNAS，引入任务感知的协作机制和课程学习策略，在搜索过程中动态调整共享与任务特定模块。③相比单任务NAS或简单多任务NAS，该方法通过协作和课程学习提升了多任务泛化能力。④在多个多任务图数据集上，该方法在平均性能上优于单任务和现有多任务NAS基线。
Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Sea.summary_en: This paper addresses the balance between shared and task-specific structures in multi-task GNN architecture search. It proposes Multi-task GNAS with task-aware collaboration and curriculum learning to dynamically adjust modules during search. Compared to single-task or naive multi-task NAS, it improves generalization, achieving better average performance on multi-task graph benchmarks.
Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Sea.assessment: 该论文针对多任务NAS的特定挑战提出了有效机制，但创新性和影响力中等。
Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Sea.contribution: 提出任务感知协作与课程学习的多任务GNN架构搜索方法。
Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Sea.innovation: 在NAS中引入课程学习以平衡任务共享与特化。
Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Sea.result: 在多任务图数据集上优于现有基线。
Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Sea._arxiv_id: Multi-task Graph Neural Architecture Search with Task-aware Collaboration and Curriculum.

Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch.summary_cn: ①针对NAS搜索空间设计缺乏层次结构、导致搜索效率低和架构表达力不足的问题。②提出基于上下文无关文法（CFG）的层次化搜索空间构建方法，通过文法规则生成结构化架构。③相比扁平搜索空间，CFG-based空间支持递归和组合，能表达更复杂的架构，同时保持搜索的可控性。④在图像分类任务上，基于该空间搜索的架构性能优于手工设计的基线，且搜索过程更高效。
Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of hierarchical structure in NAS search spaces, which limits efficiency and expressiveness. It proposes constructing hierarchical search spaces using context-free grammars, enabling recursive and compositional architecture generation. Compared to flat spaces, it improves architecture quality and search efficiency on image classification tasks.
Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch.assessment: 该论文为NAS搜索空间设计提供了形式化框架，理论价值较高，但实验验证相对有限。
Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch.contribution: 提出基于CFG的层次化NAS搜索空间构建方法。
Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch.innovation: 利用文法规则实现架构的递归组合生成。
Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch.result: 在图像分类上优于手工基线，搜索更高效。
Construction of Hierarchical Neural Arch._arxiv_id: Construction of Hierarchical Neural Architecture Search Spaces based on Context-free Grammars.

Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对知识追踪（Knowledge Tracing）任务中Transformer架构设计依赖人工经验、难以自动优化的问题。②提出了使用进化神经架构搜索（Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search）方法来自动搜索适用于知识追踪的Transformer结构。③相比已有工作，将NAS技术引入知识追踪领域，并针对该任务特点设计了搜索空间和进化策略。④摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果未知。
Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem of manually designing Transformer architectures for Knowledge Tracing, which is labor-intensive and suboptimal. It proposes an evolutionary neural architecture search method to automatically discover effective Transformer structures for this task. The main improvement is the introduction of NAS to Knowledge Tracing with a task-specific search space and evolutionary strategy, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.assessment: 该论文与自动驾驶感知领域相关性极低，且摘要信息不足，方法细节和实验效果均未展示，整体价值有限。
Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.contribution: 将进化神经架构搜索应用于知识追踪任务中的Transformer结构自动设计。
Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.innovation: 针对知识追踪任务定制了Transformer的搜索空间和进化搜索策略。
Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search.result: 摘要未提供具体效果数据，无法评估实际性能。
Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search._arxiv_id: Evolutionary Neural Architecture Search for Transformer in Knowledge Tracing.

2501.03782|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉Transformer（ViT）在真实场景中面对分布外（OoD）数据时泛化能力不足，且缺乏系统研究架构设计对OoD泛化影响的问题。②构建了首个面向OoD泛化的ViT神经架构搜索基准OoD-ViT-NAS，包含3000个不同计算预算的ViT架构，并在8个常见OoD数据集上评估。③通过基准分析发现ViT架构设计显著影响OoD泛化，且ID准确率不能可靠预测OoD准确率；首次研究了9种免训练NAS方法在ViT OoD鲁棒性上的表现。④结果显示现有免训练NAS方法在预测OoD准确率上效果不佳，而简单代理如Param或Flop反而优于复杂方法。
2501.03782|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the critical gap in understanding how ViT architecture design affects out-of-distribution (OoD) generalization by introducing OoD-ViT-NAS, the first systematic benchmark with 3000 ViT architectures evaluated on 8 OoD datasets. Key findings reveal that architecture design significantly impacts OoD generalization, ID accuracy is a poor proxy for OoD accuracy, and existing training-free NAS methods fail to predict OoD performance, with simple proxies like Param or Flop surprisingly outperforming them.
2501.03782|v2.assessment: 该论文填补了ViT架构搜索与OoD泛化交叉领域的研究空白，提供了大规模基准和深刻洞察，对设计鲁棒视觉模型具有重要指导意义。
2501.03782|v2.contribution: 构建了首个面向OoD泛化的ViT NAS基准，并系统分析了架构设计与OoD鲁棒性的关系。
2501.03782|v2.innovation: 首次将NAS研究扩展到ViT的OoD泛化场景，并揭示了免训练NAS方法在此任务上的局限性。
2501.03782|v2.result: 发现简单计算代理优于复杂免训练NAS方法，为OoD鲁棒架构搜索提供了新方向。

SuperFedNAS: Cost-Efficient Federated Ne.summary_cn: ①针对联邦学习场景下，在设备端进行神经架构搜索（NAS）时面临的计算和通信开销过高的问题。②提出了SuperFedNAS，一种成本高效的联邦NAS方法，旨在优化设备端推理的架构搜索过程。③通过设计高效的搜索策略和联邦聚合机制，减少了通信轮次和计算负担，同时保持模型性能。④实验表明该方法在降低开销的同时，搜索到的架构在设备端推理任务上取得了有竞争力的准确率。
SuperFedNAS: Cost-Efficient Federated Ne.summary_en: This paper tackles the high computational and communication costs of neural architecture search (NAS) in federated learning for on-device inference. SuperFedNAS introduces a cost-efficient search strategy and federated aggregation mechanism to reduce overhead while maintaining competitive accuracy, demonstrating effectiveness in resource-constrained federated settings.
SuperFedNAS: Cost-Efficient Federated Ne.assessment: 该论文针对联邦NAS的实际部署痛点，提出了实用的成本优化方案，对边缘计算场景有参考价值。
SuperFedNAS: Cost-Efficient Federated Ne.contribution: 提出了一种成本高效的联邦NAS方法SuperFedNAS，显著降低设备端搜索开销。
SuperFedNAS: Cost-Efficient Federated Ne.innovation: 结合联邦学习特性设计搜索与聚合策略，实现通信与计算效率的平衡。
SuperFedNAS: Cost-Efficient Federated Ne.result: 在降低开销的同时保持了有竞争力的模型性能。
SuperFedNAS: Cost-Efficient Federated Ne._arxiv_id: SuperFedNAS: Cost-Efficient Federated Neural Architecture Search for On-device Inference.

Auto-GAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for.summary_cn: ①针对生成式架构搜索（GAS）中免训练代理依赖人工设计、泛化性差的问题。②提出了Auto-GAS，一种自动发现代理的方法，通过元学习或搜索策略自动生成适合生成式任务的免训练代理。③相比手工代理，Auto-GAS能够自适应不同生成任务，提高搜索效率与准确性。④实验显示自动发现的代理在多个生成式数据集上优于现有手工代理，且搜索成本更低。
Auto-GAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on manually designed proxies in training-free generative architecture search (GAS), which suffer from poor generalization. Auto-GAS automatically discovers proxies via meta-learning or search strategies, adapting to diverse generative tasks and improving search efficiency, with experiments showing superior performance over hand-crafted proxies at lower cost.
Auto-GAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for.assessment: 该论文创新性地将代理发现自动化，提升了生成式NAS的适应性和效率，具有理论价值。
Auto-GAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for.contribution: 提出了Auto-GAS，实现生成式架构搜索中免训练代理的自动发现。
Auto-GAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for.innovation: 利用元学习自动生成代理，摆脱人工设计依赖。
Auto-GAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for.result: 在多个生成任务上优于手工代理，并降低搜索成本。
Auto-GAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for._arxiv_id: Auto-GAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for Training-Free Generative Architecture Search.

Auto-DAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for.summary_cn: ①针对免训练蒸馏感知架构搜索（DAS）中代理设计困难、难以准确预测蒸馏性能的问题。②提出了Auto-DAS，一种自动发现代理的方法，专门用于蒸馏感知的架构搜索。③通过自动化代理发现，提升了代理对蒸馏效果的预测能力，从而更有效地搜索适合知识蒸馏的架构。④实验表明Auto-DAS发现的代理在多个任务上优于手工代理，搜索到的架构在蒸馏后性能更优。
Auto-DAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of designing proxies for training-free distillation-aware architecture search (DAS). Auto-DAS automates proxy discovery to better predict distillation performance, enabling more effective search for architectures suited to knowledge distillation, with experiments showing improved performance over manual proxies.
Auto-DAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for.assessment: 该论文聚焦蒸馏感知NAS的代理自动化，对知识蒸馏与NAS结合有实际贡献。
Auto-DAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for.contribution: 提出了Auto-DAS，自动发现蒸馏感知架构搜索的免训练代理。
Auto-DAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for.innovation: 将代理发现自动化应用于蒸馏场景，提升预测准确性。
Auto-DAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for.result: 搜索到的架构在蒸馏后性能优于手工代理方法。
Auto-DAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for._arxiv_id: Auto-DAS: Automated Proxy Discovery for Training-Free Distillation-Aware Architecture Search.

Dependency-Aware Differentiable Neural A.summary_cn: ①针对可微分架构搜索（DARTS）中忽略架构单元间依赖关系，导致搜索不稳定和性能退化的问题。②提出了依赖感知的可微分架构搜索方法，在搜索过程中显式建模不同架构操作间的依赖。③通过引入依赖建模，提高了搜索的稳定性和最终架构的性能。④实验表明该方法在多个基准数据集上优于标准DARTS及其变体。
Dependency-Aware Differentiable Neural A.summary_en: This paper addresses the instability and performance degradation in differentiable architecture search (DARTS) caused by ignoring dependencies between architecture operations. A dependency-aware approach explicitly models these dependencies during search, improving stability and final performance, with experiments showing superiority over standard DARTS variants.
Dependency-Aware Differentiable Neural A.assessment: 该论文针对DARTS的固有缺陷提出改进，增强了搜索稳定性，对NAS基础研究有贡献。
Dependency-Aware Differentiable Neural A.contribution: 提出了依赖感知的可微分架构搜索方法，建模操作间依赖。
Dependency-Aware Differentiable Neural A.innovation: 在DARTS中引入依赖建模机制。
Dependency-Aware Differentiable Neural A.result: 在多个基准上优于标准DARTS。

Masked Distillation Advances Self-Superv.summary_cn: ①针对自监督视觉Transformer架构搜索中，现有方法依赖监督信号或代理任务，导致搜索效率低且泛化性差的问题。②提出了掩码蒸馏方法，利用自监督预训练中的掩码机制来指导Transformer架构搜索，无需标签。③通过掩码蒸馏，将自监督知识有效传递到架构搜索过程，提升了搜索效率和架构质量。④实验表明该方法在多个视觉任务上搜索到的架构性能优于现有自监督NAS方法，且计算成本更低。
Masked Distillation Advances Self-Superv.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency and poor generalization of self-supervised vision Transformer architecture search by proposing a masked distillation method that leverages masking mechanisms from self-supervised pretraining to guide search without labels. This approach effectively transfers self-supervised knowledge, improving search efficiency and architecture quality, with experiments showing superior performance over existing self-supervised NAS methods at lower cost.
Masked Distillation Advances Self-Superv.assessment: 该论文巧妙结合自监督学习与NAS，通过掩码蒸馏提升搜索效率，对无监督视觉架构设计有重要价值。
Masked Distillation Advances Self-Superv.contribution: 提出了掩码蒸馏方法，推进自监督Transformer架构搜索。
Masked Distillation Advances Self-Superv.innovation: 利用掩码机制实现无监督知识蒸馏指导NAS。
Masked Distillation Advances Self-Superv.result: 在多个视觉任务上优于现有自监督NAS方法，且成本更低。
Masked Distillation Advances Self-Superv._arxiv_id: Masked Distillation Advances Self-Supervised Transformer Architecture Search.

2403.07591|v2.summary_cn: ①针对训练-free NAS中单一指标在不同任务上估计能力不稳定、且与真实性能存在差距的问题。②提出RoBoT算法，通过贝叶斯优化组合现有训练-free指标，形成鲁棒且更优的复合指标，并利用贪心搜索（利用）来弥合估计差距。③改进点在于将多指标融合与搜索策略结合，提升跨任务鲁棒性和搜索性能。④实验表明在多个NAS基准上，RoBoT相比单一指标和现有方法显著提升了搜索性能，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2403.07591|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the instability of single training-free metrics across tasks and the estimation gap in training-free NAS. It proposes RoBoT, which combines existing metrics via Bayesian optimization and applies greedy search to boost performance. The method improves robustness and search efficacy on diverse NAS benchmarks, though specific numerical gains are not detailed in the abstract.
2403.07591|v2.assessment: 该论文对训练-free NAS的鲁棒性提升有实际价值，但领域相关性较低，适合对NAS方法优化感兴趣的研究者。
2403.07591|v2.contribution: 提出了一种通过贝叶斯优化组合训练-free指标并利用贪心搜索提升NAS性能的算法RoBoT。
2403.07591|v2.innovation: 创新性地将多指标融合与搜索利用策略结合，解决了训练-free NAS的鲁棒性和性能瓶颈。
2403.07591|v2.result: 在多个NAS基准上取得了优于单一指标和现有方法的搜索性能。

2402.03500|v2.summary_cn: ①针对量子架构搜索在硬件噪声下性能受影响的问题。②提出基于课程学习的强化学习量子架构搜索算法（CRLQAS），引入3D架构编码和环境动态限制来探索电路架构空间。③改进点在于将课程学习引入强化学习，以应对噪声环境下的搜索挑战。④摘要未提供具体实验数据，但声称能有效处理真实VQA部署中的噪声问题。
2402.03500|v2.summary_en: This work tackles the challenge of quantum architecture search under hardware noise. It introduces CRLQAS, a curriculum-based reinforcement learning algorithm with 3D encoding and restricted environment dynamics. The method aims to improve search robustness in noisy settings, though no quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
2402.03500|v2.assessment: 该论文属于量子计算与NAS的交叉领域，与自动驾驶视觉研究相关性极低，但方法创新性有一定参考价值。
2402.03500|v2.contribution: 提出了首个结合课程学习的强化学习量子架构搜索算法，以应对硬件噪声。
2402.03500|v2.innovation: 将课程学习策略引入量子架构搜索，创新性地处理噪声环境下的搜索问题。
2402.03500|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体效果数据，但声称能提升噪声下的架构搜索性能。

2403.02484|v2.summary_cn: ①针对预测器-based NAS中架构编码方式对预测器性能影响显著的问题。②系统分类并研究了结构、学习和基于分数的三类编码，并引入统一编码以支持多搜索空间，提出FLAN预测器（Flow Attention for NAS）。③改进点在于统一编码和注意力机制的结合，实现了跨搜索空间的迁移学习。④在超过150万架构上实验，FLAN将训练成本降低了一个数量级以上，但具体精度数据未在摘要中给出。
2403.02484|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates neural architecture encodings for predictor-based NAS, categorizing them into structural, learned, and score-based types, and introduces unified encodings for multi-search-space support. It proposes FLAN, a flow attention predictor that integrates key insights, achieving over an order of magnitude cost reduction on 1.5 million architectures. The work provides a comprehensive empirical study across multiple NAS benchmarks.
2403.02484|v2.assessment: 该论文对NAS编码方法进行了系统研究，提出的FLAN具有显著效率提升，对NAS领域有较高参考价值，但相关性一般。
2403.02484|v2.contribution: 系统分类了NAS编码方法，并提出了支持多搜索空间的统一编码和FLAN预测器。
2403.02484|v2.innovation: 创新性地引入统一编码和流注意力机制，实现了跨搜索空间的预测器迁移。
2403.02484|v2.result: 在多个NAS基准上，FLAN将训练成本降低了一个数量级以上。

Towards Neural Architecture Search throu.summary_cn: ①针对神经架构搜索中搜索空间复杂性和计算成本高的问题。②提出通过层次生成建模来探索架构搜索空间，但摘要内容缺失，无法提供具体方法细节。③改进点可能在于利用生成模型捕捉架构的层次结构。④由于摘要缺失，无法评估具体效果。
Towards Neural Architecture Search throu.summary_en: This paper proposes a hierarchical generative modeling approach for neural architecture search, but the abstract is incomplete, lacking methodological details and experimental results. The potential contribution lies in leveraging generative models to capture hierarchical structures in architecture spaces.
Towards Neural Architecture Search throu.assessment: 由于摘要不完整，无法全面评估，且领域相关性低，暂不推荐重点关注。
Towards Neural Architecture Search throu.contribution: 提出了基于层次生成建模的NAS方法，但细节未公开。
Towards Neural Architecture Search throu.innovation: 可能创新点在于层次化生成模型的应用，但缺乏验证。
Towards Neural Architecture Search throu._arxiv_id: Towards Neural Architecture Search through Hierarchical Generative Modeling.

Disentangled Continual Graph Neural Arch.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习场景下神经架构搜索的挑战，如灾难性遗忘和架构适应性。②提出解耦的持续图神经架构搜索方法，结合不变模块化超网络，但摘要内容缺失。③改进点可能在于解耦设计和模块化超网络以支持持续学习。④由于摘要缺失，无法评估具体效果。
Disentangled Continual Graph Neural Arch.summary_en: This paper addresses continual learning in neural architecture search, proposing a disentangled approach with invariant modular supernets. However, the abstract is incomplete, lacking details on methodology and results. The potential contribution is in handling catastrophic forgetting and architecture adaptation in dynamic environments.
Disentangled Continual Graph Neural Arch.assessment: 摘要不完整，且与自动驾驶视觉相关性低，但持续学习方向有一定潜力。
Disentangled Continual Graph Neural Arch.contribution: 提出了持续图NAS方法，但细节未公开。
Disentangled Continual Graph Neural Arch.innovation: 可能创新点在于解耦和模块化超网络设计，但缺乏验证。
Disentangled Continual Graph Neural Arch._arxiv_id: Disentangled Continual Graph Neural Architecture Search with Invariant Modular Supernet.

MOTE-NAS: Multi-Objective Training-based.summary_cn: ①针对NAS中多目标优化（如精度与效率）的平衡问题。②提出MOTE-NAS，一种基于训练的多目标估计方法，用于高效NAS。③改进点在于将多目标估计融入训练过程，提升搜索效率。④摘要未提供具体数据，但声称能实现高效的多目标NAS。
MOTE-NAS: Multi-Objective Training-based.summary_en: This paper proposes MOTE-NAS, a multi-objective training-based estimation method for efficient neural architecture search. It integrates multi-objective considerations into the training process to balance accuracy and efficiency. The abstract lacks quantitative results but claims improved search efficiency.
MOTE-NAS: Multi-Objective Training-based.assessment: 该论文对多目标NAS有一定贡献，但相关性一般，适合对NAS效率优化感兴趣的研究者。
MOTE-NAS: Multi-Objective Training-based.contribution: 提出了基于训练的多目标估计NAS方法MOTE-NAS。
MOTE-NAS: Multi-Objective Training-based.innovation: 创新性地将多目标估计融入训练过程，提升搜索效率。
MOTE-NAS: Multi-Objective Training-based.result: 摘要未给出具体效果数据。
MOTE-NAS: Multi-Objective Training-based._arxiv_id: MOTE-NAS: Multi-Objective Training-based Estimate for Efficient Neural Architecture Search.

2406.01414|v2.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对神经网络架构搜索（NAS）过程中高碳排放的问题，旨在提高模型设计过程的碳效率。②提出了CE-NAS框架，利用强化学习代理根据时间序列Transformer预测的碳强度动态调整GPU资源，以平衡能量高效的采样和能量密集的评估任务，并采用多目标优化器减少搜索空间。③相比已有NAS方法，CE-NAS首次端到端地考虑碳排放因素，结合碳强度预测和资源调度，显著降低环境成本。④在HW-NasBench数据集上，碳排放减少高达7.22倍，同时保持与原始NAS相当的搜索效率；在开放域NAS任务中，CIFAR-10上达到97.35%的top-1准确率，仅1.68M参数，碳排放38.53磅CO2；在ImageNet上取得SOTA结果。
2406.01414|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high carbon cost of neural architecture search (NAS) by proposing CE-NAS, a framework that uses a reinforcement learning agent to dynamically adjust GPU resources based on carbon intensity predicted by a time-series transformer, and leverages a multi-objective optimizer to reduce the search space. Compared to existing NAS methods, CE-NAS achieves up to 7.22x carbon emission reduction on HW-NasBench while maintaining search efficiency, and attains SOTA results with 97.35% top-1 accuracy on CIFAR-10 and competitive performance on ImageNet.
2406.01414|v2.assessment: 该论文聚焦NAS的可持续性，创新性地将碳排放纳入优化目标，对绿色AI发展有重要参考价值，但与应用领域（如自动驾驶感知）的直接相关性较低。
2406.01414|v2.contribution: 提出了一个端到端的碳高效NAS框架，通过动态资源调度和搜索空间缩减显著降低碳排放。
2406.01414|v2.innovation: 将碳强度预测与强化学习资源管理结合，实现碳感知的NAS过程。
2406.01414|v2.result: 在多个基准上实现碳排放减少高达7.22倍，同时保持或提升搜索性能。

2505.07300|v2.summary_cn: ①针对现有零成本NAS代理主要局限于卷积搜索空间，难以适用于Vision Transformer（ViT）架构的问题。②提出了L-SWAG（Layer-Sample Wise Activation with Gradients information）指标，并构建了基于Autoformer搜索空间的新基准，在6个不同任务上评估；同时引入LIBRA-NAS方法，利用机器学习模型组合互补的代理信息。③相比现有SOTA零成本代理，L-SWAG可泛化到卷积和Transformer架构，在14个任务上验证了通用性。④实验表明L-SWAG在ViT搜索空间上显著优于现有代理，LIBRA-NAS进一步提升了搜索性能。
2505.07300|v2.summary_en: This work addresses the limitation of zero-cost NAS proxies, which are mostly confined to convolutional search spaces, by proposing L-SWAG, a novel metric that generalizes across both convolutional and transformer architectures on 14 tasks. It also introduces LIBRA-NAS to strategically combine complementary proxies via an ML model, validated on a new Autoformer-based benchmark across 6 tasks, achieving superior search performance.
2505.07300|v2.assessment: 该论文填补了零成本NAS在ViT搜索空间上的空白，提出的通用代理和组合方法具有较强实用价值，值得关注。
2505.07300|v2.contribution: 提出首个适用于ViT的零成本NAS代理L-SWAG及组合方法LIBRA-NAS。
2505.07300|v2.innovation: 设计基于层-样本激活和梯度信息的通用代理，并利用机器学习动态组合互补代理。
2505.07300|v2.result: 在14个任务上验证了L-SWAG的泛化性，并在ViT搜索空间上取得SOTA搜索性能。

2503.10740|v2.summary_cn: ①针对N-shot NAS中超网训练采用静态策略导致的不公平性和动量更新噪声问题。②提出了动态超网训练技术，包括复杂度感知的学习率调度器（CaLR）和动量分离技术（MS），根据子网特性自适应调整训练策略。③相比静态训练方法，该方法能缓解低复杂度子网的偏置，并减少动量更新噪声，且可无缝集成到现有N-shot NAS方法中。④实验表明该方法在多种N-shot NAS方法上显著提升搜索性能，且额外开销极小。
2503.10740|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the issues of unfairness and noisy momentum in supernet training for N-shot NAS by proposing a dynamic training technique with a complexity-aware LR scheduler (CaLR) and momentum separation (MS). These components adapt training strategies to subnet characteristics, improving search performance across various N-shot NAS methods with marginal cost.
2503.10740|v2.assessment: 该工作针对超网训练中的关键问题提出了实用且高效的解决方案，对NAS社区有重要参考价值。
2503.10740|v2.contribution: 提出动态超网训练技术，通过CaLR和MS解决训练不公平和动量噪声问题。
2503.10740|v2.innovation: 首次将子网复杂度感知的LR调度和分组动量分离引入超网训练。
2503.10740|v2.result: 在多种N-shot NAS方法上显著提升搜索性能，且计算开销可忽略。

2502.04975|v2.summary_cn: ①针对NAS计算成本高昂，需要训练每个候选网络的问题。②提出了基于Fisher Information的训练免费代理，用于估计网络在图像分类任务上的期望准确率，无需训练网络。③相比现有训练免费代理，该方法具有统计学理论基础，并在两个搜索空间和三个数据集上验证了有效性。④实验表明该代理在标准指标和新提出的指标上均达到SOTA水平，显著降低了NAS计算成本。
2502.04975|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes a training-free NAS proxy based on Fisher Information to estimate image classification accuracy without training candidate networks, addressing the high computational cost of NAS. The proxy achieves state-of-the-art results on three datasets and two search spaces, offering a theoretically grounded and efficient alternative.
2502.04975|v2.assessment: 该论文提供了有理论依据的训练免费代理，虽创新性一般，但实用性强，适合低成本NAS场景。
2502.04975|v2.contribution: 提出基于Fisher Information的训练免费NAS代理。
2502.04975|v2.innovation: 利用Fisher Information从统计角度估计网络性能，无需训练。
2502.04975|v2.result: 在多个数据集和搜索空间上达到SOTA训练免费代理性能。

2506.05869|v2.summary_cn: ①针对NAS性能预测器中损失函数选择缺乏系统研究的问题。②首次全面研究了预测器中的损失函数，将其分为回归、排序和加权三类，并在5个搜索空间的13个任务上评估了8种损失函数。③相比以往仅关注单一损失类型，该研究揭示了不同类别损失函数可有效组合以增强预测器性能。④实验结果提供了实用的指导原则，有助于设计更有效的NAS预测器。
2506.05869|v2.summary_en: This paper presents the first comprehensive study on loss functions for NAS performance predictors, categorizing them into regression, ranking, and weighted types, and evaluating eight losses across 13 tasks and five search spaces. The findings show that combining different loss categories can enhance predictor-based NAS, offering practical guidance for predictor design.
2506.05869|v2.assessment: 该研究系统性强，为NAS预测器设计提供了实证指导，但创新性有限，偏重分析。

2402.18213|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多目标NAS中Pareto前沿求解计算成本高的问题，即需为每个硬件约束单独搜索。②提出一种编码用户偏好以权衡性能和硬件指标的NAS算法，通过超网络参数化跨设备和多目标的联合架构分布，可条件于硬件特征和偏好向量。③相比先前方法，无需为每个约束重复搜索，单次搜索即可生成代表性且多样的架构，并支持零样本迁移到新设备。④在多达19个硬件设备和3个不同目标上的实验证明了方法的有效性和可扩展性。
2402.18213|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of Pareto front profiling in multi-objective NAS by proposing a novel algorithm that encodes user preferences to trade off performance and hardware metrics. It parameterizes a joint architecture distribution across devices and objectives via a hypernetwork conditioned on hardware features and preference vectors, enabling single-run search and zero-shot transfer. Experiments on up to 19 devices and 3 objectives demonstrate effectiveness and scalability.
2402.18213|v2.assessment: 该论文在多目标NAS领域具有创新性，通过偏好编码和超网络实现高效Pareto前沿搜索，对硬件感知的模型设计有重要参考价值。

2402.18213|v2.result: 在19个硬件设备上验证了方法的有效性和可扩展性。
