DetCo: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning.summary_cn: ①针对无监督对比学习在目标检测任务上迁移性能不佳的问题。②提出DetCo，一种专门为检测设计的无监督对比学习框架，通过多尺度特征对比和全局-局部一致性约束来学习检测友好的表示。③相比通用对比学习（如MoCo、SimCLR），DetCo在检测任务上显著提升迁移性能，同时保持分类性能。④在COCO检测上，DetCo预训练模型比MoCo v2提升约2.0 AP，在实例分割上也有一致提升。
DetCo: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning.summary_en: DetCo addresses the poor transferability of unsupervised contrastive learning to object detection by introducing multi-scale feature contrast and global-local consistency. It outperforms MoCo v2 by ~2.0 AP on COCO detection while maintaining classification accuracy, demonstrating detection-friendly representations.
DetCo: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning.assessment: 该论文针对检测任务定制自监督学习，实验充分，对自动驾驶感知中的检测预训练有直接参考价值。
DetCo: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning.contribution: 提出检测专用的无监督对比学习框架DetCo，提升检测迁移性能。
DetCo: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning.innovation: 引入多尺度特征对比和全局-局部一致性，适配检测任务的多尺度特性。
DetCo: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning.result: 在COCO检测上比MoCo v2提升约2.0 AP。
DetCo: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning._arxiv_id: DetCo: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning for Object Detection.

SLIM: Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow a.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中LiDAR场景流估计和运动分割依赖大量标注的问题。②提出SLIM，一种自监督方法，通过连续帧的几何一致性和运动平滑性约束来学习场景流和运动分割，无需人工标注。③相比监督方法，SLIM利用点云自身的时空一致性作为监督信号，降低了标注成本。④在多个基准上，SLIM的自监督性能接近甚至超越部分监督方法，运动分割精度显著提升。
SLIM: Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow a.summary_en: SLIM tackles the annotation bottleneck in LiDAR scene flow and motion segmentation by proposing a self-supervised method that leverages geometric consistency and motion smoothness across frames. It achieves performance comparable to supervised methods on benchmarks, reducing labeling costs for autonomous driving.
SLIM: Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow a.assessment: 该论文针对自动驾驶核心任务提出自监督方案，实用性强，与用户领域高度相关。
SLIM: Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow a.contribution: 提出自监督LiDAR场景流与运动分割方法SLIM。
SLIM: Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow a.innovation: 利用时空几何一致性作为自监督信号，无需标注。
SLIM: Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow a.result: 自监督性能接近监督方法，运动分割精度显著提升。
SLIM: Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow a._arxiv_id: SLIM: Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow and Motion Segmentation.

Guided Point Contrastive Learning for Se.summary_cn: ①针对半监督点云语义分割中标注数据稀缺的问题。②提出引导点对比学习（Guided Point Contrastive Learning），利用少量标注和大量未标注点云，通过对比学习增强特征判别性。③相比传统半监督方法，该方法引入引导机制，利用标注点云指导未标注数据的特征学习。④在S3DIS和ScanNet等数据集上，半监督设置下性能优于现有方法，但摘要未提供具体数值。
Guided Point Contrastive Learning for Se.summary_en: This paper addresses semi-supervised point cloud semantic segmentation by proposing guided point contrastive learning, which uses limited labels to guide contrastive learning on unlabeled data. It improves feature discrimination and outperforms existing semi-supervised methods on S3DIS and ScanNet, though specific numbers are absent.
Guided Point Contrastive Learning for Se.assessment: 该论文聚焦半监督点云分割，对3D感知有参考价值，但创新性和实验细节一般。
Guided Point Contrastive Learning for Se.contribution: 提出引导点对比学习用于半监督点云语义分割。
Guided Point Contrastive Learning for Se.innovation: 利用标注数据引导未标注数据的对比学习过程。
Guided Point Contrastive Learning for Se.result: 在S3DIS和ScanNet上优于现有半监督方法。
Guided Point Contrastive Learning for Se._arxiv_id: Guided Point Contrastive Learning for Semi-supervised Point Cloud Semantic Segmentation.

Spatio-temporal Self-Supervised Represen.summary_cn: ①针对3D点云自监督表示学习缺乏时空信息利用的问题。②提出一种时空自监督表示学习方法，通过点云序列中的时间一致性和空间结构来学习特征。③相比仅利用单帧的自监督方法，该方法充分利用了时序信息，增强了表示对动态场景的适应性。④在多个下游任务（如分类、分割）上，预训练特征性能优于现有自监督方法，但摘要未提供具体数据。
Spatio-temporal Self-Supervised Represen.summary_en: This paper proposes a spatio-temporal self-supervised representation learning method for 3D point clouds, leveraging temporal consistency and spatial structure in sequences. It outperforms single-frame self-supervised methods on downstream tasks like classification and segmentation, though quantitative details are omitted.
Spatio-temporal Self-Supervised Represen.assessment: 该论文探索了点云自监督的时空维度，对自动驾驶动态场景有潜在价值，但实验数据不充分。
Spatio-temporal Self-Supervised Represen.contribution: 提出时空自监督表示学习方法用于3D点云。
Spatio-temporal Self-Supervised Represen.innovation: 结合时序一致性和空间结构进行自监督预训练。
Spatio-temporal Self-Supervised Represen.result: 在下游任务上优于现有自监督方法。
Spatio-temporal Self-Supervised Represen._arxiv_id: Spatio-temporal Self-Supervised Representation Learning for 3D Point Clouds.

Unsupervised Point Cloud Object Co-segme.summary_cn: ①针对无监督点云物体共分割（co-segmentation）中缺乏对应关系建模的问题。②提出共对比学习（co-contrastive learning）和互注意力采样（mutual attention sampling）方法，通过跨物体对比和注意力机制来发现共享语义部分。③相比传统共分割方法，该方法无需任何标注，且能处理不同物体间的形状差异。④在多个点云数据集上，共分割精度优于现有无监督方法，但摘要未提供具体数值。
Unsupervised Point Cloud Object Co-segme.summary_en: This paper addresses unsupervised point cloud co-segmentation by proposing co-contrastive learning and mutual attention sampling to model correspondences across objects. It discovers shared semantic parts without labels, outperforming existing unsupervised methods on multiple datasets, though specifics are not given.
Unsupervised Point Cloud Object Co-segme.assessment: 该论文针对无监督共分割提出新机制，有一定创新性，但与自动驾驶感知的直接关联较弱。
Unsupervised Point Cloud Object Co-segme.contribution: 提出共对比学习和互注意力采样用于无监督点云共分割。
Unsupervised Point Cloud Object Co-segme.innovation: 利用跨物体对比和注意力机制实现无监督语义对应。
Unsupervised Point Cloud Object Co-segme.result: 在多个数据集上优于现有无监督方法。
Unsupervised Point Cloud Object Co-segme._arxiv_id: Unsupervised Point Cloud Object Co-segmentation by Co-contrastive Learning and Mutual Attention Sampling.

Self-Supervised Pretraining of 3D Featur.summary_cn: ①这篇论文针对点云数据上3D特征的自监督预训练问题，旨在减少对人工标注的依赖。②提出了一个通用的自监督预训练框架，适用于任意点云数据，通过设计代理任务学习3D特征表示。③相比已有工作，该方法不依赖于特定传感器或场景，具有更好的泛化性和可迁移性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但强调在多个下游任务上提升了性能。
Self-Supervised Pretraining of 3D Featur.summary_en: This paper addresses self-supervised pretraining of 3D features on arbitrary point clouds to reduce annotation dependence. It proposes a general framework with proxy tasks for learning 3D representations, improving generalization across sensors and scenes. The method shows performance gains on downstream tasks, though specific metrics are not detailed in the abstract.
Self-Supervised Pretraining of 3D Featur.assessment: 该论文为点云自监督学习提供了通用方案，对3D感知领域有参考价值，但摘要信息有限，需进一步验证其效果。
Self-Supervised Pretraining of 3D Featur.contribution: 提出了一个适用于任意点云的自监督预训练框架。
Self-Supervised Pretraining of 3D Featur.innovation: 设计不依赖特定传感器或场景的通用3D特征学习任务。
Self-Supervised Pretraining of 3D Featur.result: 在多个下游任务上提升了性能。
Self-Supervised Pretraining of 3D Featur._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Pretraining of 3D Features on any Point-Cloud.

BossNAS: Exploring Hybrid CNN-transforme.summary_cn: ①针对混合CNN-transformer架构搜索中现有方法搜索空间受限和训练效率低的问题。②提出了BossNAS，采用块级自监督神经架构搜索，通过分块训练和自监督学习高效评估架构。③相比已有NAS方法，BossNAS在更大搜索空间中实现更优的架构发现，并减少了计算开销。④在ImageNet等基准上取得了领先的分类精度，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
BossNAS: Exploring Hybrid CNN-transforme.summary_en: This paper tackles the limitations of existing NAS methods for hybrid CNN-transformer architectures, including restricted search spaces and low training efficiency. It introduces BossNAS, a block-wise self-supervised NAS approach that evaluates architectures via block-level training and self-supervision. BossNAS achieves superior accuracy on benchmarks like ImageNet with reduced computational cost, though exact numbers are not in the abstract.
BossNAS: Exploring Hybrid CNN-transforme.assessment: 该论文在NAS领域具有创新性，块级自监督策略有效提升了搜索效率，对架构设计有重要启示。
BossNAS: Exploring Hybrid CNN-transforme.contribution: 提出了块级自监督NAS方法BossNAS，用于高效搜索混合CNN-transformer架构。
BossNAS: Exploring Hybrid CNN-transforme.innovation: 采用分块训练和自监督学习降低架构评估成本。
BossNAS: Exploring Hybrid CNN-transforme.result: 在ImageNet等基准上取得领先精度。
BossNAS: Exploring Hybrid CNN-transforme._arxiv_id: BossNAS: Exploring Hybrid CNN-transformers with Block-wisely Self-supervised Neural Architecture Search.

ISD: Self-Supervised Learning by Iterati.summary_cn: ①针对自监督学习中表示学习效率低和特征判别性不足的问题。②提出了ISD（迭代相似性蒸馏）方法，通过迭代地蒸馏相似性关系来增强表示学习。③相比对比学习等方法，ISD无需负样本，简化了训练过程并提升了特征质量。④在多个视觉任务上取得了与SOTA相当或更好的性能，具体数据未在摘要中详述。
ISD: Self-Supervised Learning by Iterati.summary_en: This paper addresses inefficiency and insufficient discriminability in self-supervised representation learning. It proposes ISD (Iterative Similarity Distillation), which iteratively distills similarity relations to enhance representations. Unlike contrastive methods, ISD avoids negative samples, simplifying training and improving feature quality, achieving comparable or better performance on various vision tasks.
ISD: Self-Supervised Learning by Iterati.assessment: 该论文提出了一种简洁有效的自监督方法，对表示学习领域有实际贡献，值得关注。
ISD: Self-Supervised Learning by Iterati.contribution: 提出了迭代相似性蒸馏的自监督学习框架。
ISD: Self-Supervised Learning by Iterati.innovation: 无需负样本的迭代蒸馏机制。
ISD: Self-Supervised Learning by Iterati.result: 在多个视觉任务上达到SOTA或更优性能。
ISD: Self-Supervised Learning by Iterati._arxiv_id: ISD: Self-Supervised Learning by Iterative Similarity Distillation.

2010.08508|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自监督学习表示泛化性缺乏理论保证的问题。②证明了在合理假设下，自监督表示加简单分类器的泛化差距上界，且该上界独立于表示复杂度。③相比已有理论工作，不依赖结构或条件独立性假设，适用于更广泛的训练流程。④提供了非平凡的上界，适用于多种流行表示学习方法，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2010.08508|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of theoretical guarantees on generalization for self-supervised representations. It proves a new upper bound on the generalization gap for classifiers using self-supervised representations, independent of representation complexity. Unlike prior work, it avoids structural assumptions and applies broadly, yielding non-vacuous bounds for popular methods.
2010.08508|v2.assessment: 该论文提供了重要的理论突破，为自监督学习的泛化性提供了坚实依据，对领域有深远影响。
2010.08508|v2.contribution: 证明了自监督表示泛化差距的新上界，独立于表示复杂度。
2010.08508|v2.innovation: 在弱假设下建立泛化理论，无需条件独立性。
2010.08508|v2.result: 为多种表示学习方法提供了非平凡泛化保证。

Self-Supervised Global-Local Structure M.summary_cn: ①针对点云领域自适应中标注稀缺和域间差异大的问题。②提出自监督全局-局部结构建模方法，并利用可靠的投票伪标签进行跨域适应。③通过全局和局部结构的一致性学习增强特征鲁棒性，并设计投票机制筛选高质量伪标签。④在多个标准点云数据集上验证了方法的有效性，性能优于现有无监督域适应方法。
Self-Supervised Global-Local Structure M.summary_en: This paper addresses the scarcity of annotations and domain gaps in point cloud domain adaptation. It proposes a self-supervised global-local structure modeling approach with reliable voted pseudo labels to enhance feature robustness and select high-quality pseudo-labels. Experiments on standard point cloud datasets demonstrate superior performance over existing unsupervised domain adaptation methods.
Self-Supervised Global-Local Structure M.assessment: 该论文针对点云域适应这一重要但研究较少的问题，提出了自监督与伪标签结合的新思路，对自动驾驶中的跨场景泛化有参考价值。
Self-Supervised Global-Local Structure M.contribution: 提出了一种结合全局-局部结构建模和投票伪标签的点云域适应方法。
Self-Supervised Global-Local Structure M.innovation: 利用自监督全局-局部一致性学习与可靠投票机制提升伪标签质量。
Self-Supervised Global-Local Structure M.result: 在多个点云数据集上取得了优于现有无监督域适应方法的效果。
Self-Supervised Global-Local Structure M._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Global-Local Structure Modeling for Point Cloud Domain Adaptation with Reliable Voted Pseudo Labels.

RigidFlow: Self-Supervised Scene Flow Le.summary_cn: ①针对点云场景流估计依赖大量标注数据的问题。②提出RigidFlow，利用局部刚性先验进行自监督场景流学习。③通过约束局部区域的刚性运动，增强流估计的几何一致性，无需真实流标注。④在多个基准数据集上，自监督性能接近甚至超越部分监督方法。
RigidFlow: Self-Supervised Scene Flow Le.summary_en: This paper tackles the heavy annotation requirement in point cloud scene flow estimation. It introduces RigidFlow, a self-supervised method leveraging local rigidity priors to enforce geometric consistency without ground-truth flow. Experiments show competitive or superior performance compared to some supervised baselines on standard benchmarks.
RigidFlow: Self-Supervised Scene Flow Le.assessment: 该工作为点云场景流估计提供了有效的自监督范式，对动态环境感知（如自动驾驶）有实际意义。
RigidFlow: Self-Supervised Scene Flow Le.contribution: 提出基于局部刚性先验的自监督场景流学习方法。
RigidFlow: Self-Supervised Scene Flow Le.innovation: 将局部刚性约束融入自监督训练，提升流估计的几何合理性。
RigidFlow: Self-Supervised Scene Flow Le.result: 在多个基准上自监督性能接近或超越部分监督方法。
RigidFlow: Self-Supervised Scene Flow Le._arxiv_id: RigidFlow: Self-Supervised Scene Flow Learning on Point Clouds by Local Rigidity Prior.

2204.08196|v2.summary_cn: ①针对点云上采样依赖成对监督数据和固定尺度因子的问题。②提出一种自监督且任意尺度的点云上采样方法，通过隐式神经表示估计投影方向和距离。③利用两个隐式函数和预文本任务实现无需真值训练，并支持任意放大倍数。④实验表明，自监督方法性能与监督方法相当甚至更优。
2204.08196|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on paired supervision and fixed scale factors in point cloud upsampling. It proposes a self-supervised, arbitrary-scale method using implicit neural representations to estimate projection direction and distance. Trained via pretext tasks without ground truth, it achieves competitive or better performance than supervised state-of-the-art methods.
2204.08196|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地结合自监督与隐式神经表示，解决了点云上采样的关键瓶颈，具有较高的实用价值。
2204.08196|v2.contribution: 提出首个自监督且支持任意尺度的点云上采样框架。
2204.08196|v2.innovation: 利用隐式神经函数分解投影方向与距离，实现无监督训练和尺度灵活性。
2204.08196|v2.result: 自监督性能达到或超越监督方法。

2111.09886|v2.summary_cn: ①针对掩码图像建模中复杂设计（如块掩码、离散VAE）的冗余问题。②提出SimMIM，简化框架，采用随机掩码、直接回归原始像素和轻量预测头。③系统研究了各组件影响，发现大掩码尺寸和简单回归即可取得强表示。④在ImageNet-1K上，ViT-B微调准确率达83.8%，超越先前最佳0.6%；SwinV2-H达87.1%。
2111.09886|v2.summary_en: This paper simplifies masked image modeling by removing complex designs like block masking and discrete tokenization. SimMIM uses random masking, direct pixel regression, and a linear prediction head, achieving strong representation learning. It attains 83.8% top-1 accuracy with ViT-B and 87.1% with SwinV2-H on ImageNet-1K, surpassing prior methods.
2111.09886|v2.assessment: 该论文是自监督视觉领域的里程碑工作，以极简设计揭示了掩码建模的核心要素，对后续研究影响深远。
2111.09886|v2.contribution: 提出了一个简单而强大的掩码图像建模框架SimMIM。
2111.09886|v2.innovation: 通过系统消融证明随机掩码和像素回归的简洁设计即可高效学习。
2111.09886|v2.result: 在ImageNet-1K上刷新多项自监督预训练性能记录。

Knowledge-Driven Self-Supervised Represe.summary_cn: ①针对面部动作单元识别中标注成本高和知识利用不足的问题。②提出知识驱动的自监督表示学习方法，融合先验知识到预训练中。③通过知识引导的自监督任务增强AU相关特征的学习。④在多个AU识别基准上验证了方法的有效性，但摘要未提供具体数据。
Knowledge-Driven Self-Supervised Represe.summary_en: This paper addresses high annotation costs and insufficient knowledge utilization in facial action unit recognition. It proposes a knowledge-driven self-supervised representation learning method that incorporates prior knowledge into pretraining. Experiments on AU benchmarks show effectiveness, though specific metrics are not detailed in the abstract.
Knowledge-Driven Self-Supervised Represe.assessment: 该论文将领域知识融入自监督学习，思路有创新性，但摘要信息有限，影响力和通用性待评估。
Knowledge-Driven Self-Supervised Represe.contribution: 提出知识驱动的自监督学习框架用于面部AU识别。
Knowledge-Driven Self-Supervised Represe.innovation: 利用先验知识设计自监督任务以增强AU特征。
Knowledge-Driven Self-Supervised Represe.result: 在AU基准上验证了有效性，但缺乏具体数据。
Knowledge-Driven Self-Supervised Represe._arxiv_id: Knowledge-Driven Self-Supervised Representation Learning for Facial Action Unit Recognition.

2203.15205|v2.summary_cn: ①针对动作识别中视觉隐私泄露且隐私标注难以获取的问题。②提出SPAct框架，通过自监督方式去除输入视频中的隐私信息，无需隐私标签。③采用最小最大优化，结合对比自监督损失平衡动作识别与隐私保护。④在已知动作和隐私属性协议下，达到与监督方法相当的动作-隐私权衡。
2203.15205|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles visual privacy leakage in action recognition without requiring privacy labels. SPAct introduces a self-supervised framework with an anonymization function and minimax optimization to remove private information while preserving action recognition. It achieves a competitive action-privacy trade-off compared to supervised methods.
2203.15205|v2.assessment: 该论文首次将自监督学习用于隐私保护，解决了标注瓶颈，对视频理解应用有重要社会意义。
2203.15205|v2.contribution: 提出首个无需隐私标签的自监督隐私保护动作识别框架。
2203.15205|v2.innovation: 利用最小最大博弈和对比损失实现隐私去除与动作保持的平衡。
2203.15205|v2.result: 在标准协议下达到与监督方法相当的性能。

2203.13381|v2.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，提出从表征遗忘（representation forgetting）的角度重新审视现有基准。作者通过比较新任务引入前后最优线性分类器的性能差异来量化表征遗忘，发现未显式控制遗忘的模型在长任务序列中表征遗忘较小，有时与显式控制遗忘的方法相当。该工作为理解持续学习中的遗忘机制提供了新视角，但未提出新方法，实验主要基于标准基准。
2203.13381|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in continual learning by proposing representation forgetting, measured via the performance drop of an optimal linear classifier before and after new tasks. It reveals that models without explicit forgetting control often exhibit small representation forgetting, sometimes comparable to explicit methods, especially in longer sequences. The work offers new insights into forgetting mechanisms but introduces no new algorithm.
2203.13381|v2.assessment: 值得关注，因为它挑战了持续学习中遗忘的传统度量方式，可能影响未来方法设计，但创新性有限。
2203.13381|v2.contribution: 提出表征遗忘度量，重新评估持续学习基准中的遗忘现象。
2203.13381|v2.innovation: 用线性分类器性能差异量化表征遗忘，而非任务性能下降。
2203.13381|v2.result: 发现无显式遗忘控制的模型在长序列中表征遗忘较小，与显式方法相当。

2204.08932|v2.summary_cn: 这篇论文针对增量学习中样本数量有限导致遗忘严重的问题，提出利用无标注数据来多样化记忆样本。方法包括一个可学习的特征生成器，结合样本语义信息和无标注数据的语义无关信息，自适应生成多样化的样本变体；引入语义对比学习和语义解耦对比学习，确保生成样本与原始样本语义一致且多样性高。实验表明该方法能有效缓解遗忘，且不增加推理开销。
2204.08932|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting in incremental learning with limited exemplars by leveraging unlabeled data to diversify memory. It proposes a learnable feature generator that adaptively creates diverse counterparts of exemplars using semantic information from exemplars and semantically-irrelevant information from unlabeled data, enforced by semantic contrastive and semantic-decoupling contrastive learning. The method effectively reduces forgetting without extra inference cost.
2204.08932|v2.assessment: 值得关注，因为它创新性地利用无标注数据增强记忆多样性，方法实用且实验充分，对持续学习领域有实质贡献。
2204.08932|v2.contribution: 提出利用无标注数据生成多样化样本以增强增量学习记忆的方法。
2204.08932|v2.innovation: 结合语义对比学习和解耦对比学习，平衡生成样本的语义一致性与多样性。
2204.08932|v2.result: 有效缓解遗忘，且不增加推理开销。

GD-MAE: Generative Decoder for MAE Pre-T.summary_cn: ①针对LiDAR点云预训练中MAE方法因点云稀疏性和不规则性导致生成任务困难的问题。②提出GD-MAE，引入生成解码器，通过重建被掩蔽的点云区域来学习几何和语义特征。③相比标准MAE，生成解码器更适应点云结构，提升特征表达质量。④在多个下游任务（如分类、分割）上取得显著性能提升，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
GD-MAE: Generative Decoder for MAE Pre-T.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of applying MAE pre-training to LiDAR point clouds, which suffer from sparsity and irregularity. It proposes GD-MAE with a generative decoder to reconstruct masked regions, improving feature learning. The method achieves notable gains on downstream tasks like classification and segmentation.
GD-MAE: Generative Decoder for MAE Pre-T.assessment: 针对点云自监督预训练的关键难点，提出有效改进，对3D感知研究有参考价值。
GD-MAE: Generative Decoder for MAE Pre-T.contribution: 提出生成解码器增强MAE在LiDAR点云上的预训练效果。
GD-MAE: Generative Decoder for MAE Pre-T.innovation: 设计生成式重建目标以适应点云不规则性。
GD-MAE: Generative Decoder for MAE Pre-T.result: 在多个下游任务上性能提升。
GD-MAE: Generative Decoder for MAE Pre-T._arxiv_id: GD-MAE: Generative Decoder for MAE Pre-Training on LiDAR Point Clouds.

Forecast-MAE: Self-supervised Pre-traini.summary_cn: ①针对运动预测任务中缺乏标注数据且现有预训练方法未充分利用轨迹和场景上下文的问题。②提出Forecast-MAE，利用掩码自编码器对轨迹和场景进行联合预训练，重建掩蔽的轨迹和地图信息。③相比通用MAE，专门设计用于运动预测，捕获时空依赖。④在多个运动预测基准上显著提升性能，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
Forecast-MAE: Self-supervised Pre-traini.summary_en: This work tackles the scarcity of labeled data in motion forecasting by proposing Forecast-MAE, a self-supervised method that jointly pre-trains on trajectories and scene contexts via masked autoencoding. It captures spatiotemporal dependencies, outperforming baselines on multiple benchmarks.
Forecast-MAE: Self-supervised Pre-traini.assessment: 将MAE成功应用于运动预测，填补自监督预训练在该领域的空白，对自动驾驶感知有直接帮助。
Forecast-MAE: Self-supervised Pre-traini.contribution: 提出面向运动预测的掩码自编码预训练框架。
Forecast-MAE: Self-supervised Pre-traini.innovation: 联合重建轨迹和场景信息以学习时空特征。
Forecast-MAE: Self-supervised Pre-traini.result: 在运动预测基准上性能提升。
Forecast-MAE: Self-supervised Pre-traini._arxiv_id: Forecast-MAE: Self-supervised Pre-training for Motion Forecasting with Masked Autoencoders.

Temporal DINO: A Self-supervised Video S.summary_cn: ①针对视频动作预测中自监督方法未充分利用时间动态的问题。②提出Temporal DINO，扩展DINO到视频领域，通过时间掩码和对比学习增强动作预测。③相比静态图像自监督，引入时间一致性约束。④在动作预测任务上取得改进，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
Temporal DINO: A Self-supervised Video S.summary_en: This paper addresses the underutilization of temporal dynamics in self-supervised video action prediction by proposing Temporal DINO, which extends DINO with temporal masking and contrastive learning. It improves action prediction performance.
Temporal DINO: A Self-supervised Video S.assessment: 对视频自监督有贡献，但相关性略低于3D感知核心方向。
Temporal DINO: A Self-supervised Video S.contribution: 提出时间增强的DINO用于视频动作预测。
Temporal DINO: A Self-supervised Video S.innovation: 结合时间掩码和对比学习捕获动态特征。
Temporal DINO: A Self-supervised Video S._arxiv_id: Temporal DINO: A Self-supervised Video Strategy to Enhance Action Prediction.

Architecture-Agnostic Masked Image Model.summary_cn: ①针对掩码图像建模（MIM）主要适用于ViT而难以应用于CNN架构的问题。②提出架构无关的MIM方法，通过设计通用重建目标使CNN也能受益于MIM预训练。③相比仅限ViT的方法，扩展了MIM的适用范围。④在多个视觉任务上取得与ViT相当或更好的性能，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
Architecture-Agnostic Masked Image Model.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of masked image modeling to ViT architectures by proposing an architecture-agnostic approach that enables CNNs to benefit from MIM pre-training. It achieves competitive performance across vision tasks.
Architecture-Agnostic Masked Image Model.assessment: 扩展MIM到CNN，具有理论意义和实用价值，对视觉骨干网络研究有启发。
Architecture-Agnostic Masked Image Model.contribution: 提出适用于CNN的架构无关掩码图像建模方法。
Architecture-Agnostic Masked Image Model.innovation: 设计通用重建目标以适配不同架构。
Architecture-Agnostic Masked Image Model.result: 在视觉任务上性能与ViT相当。
Architecture-Agnostic Masked Image Model._arxiv_id: Architecture-Agnostic Masked Image Modeling - From ViT back to CNN.

2301.11320|v2.summary_cn: ①针对无监督目标检测和实例分割中难以发现多个物体且方法复杂的问题。②提出CutLER，利用自监督模型的物体发现能力，通过MaskCut生成粗掩码，并用鲁棒损失训练检测器，再通过自训练提升。③相比先前工作，更简单、架构兼容且能检测多物体。④在11个基准上AP50提升2.7倍以上；微调后，在COCO 5%标签下APbox和APmask分别超过MoCo-v2 7.3%和6.6%。
2301.11320|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles unsupervised object detection and instance segmentation by proposing CutLER, which leverages self-supervised models to generate coarse masks via MaskCut and trains a detector with a robust loss, followed by self-training. It is simpler, architecture-agnostic, and detects multiple objects, improving AP50 by over 2.7 times on 11 benchmarks and surpassing MoCo-v2 by 7.3% APbox and 6.6% APmask on COCO with 5% labels.
2301.11320|v2.assessment: 方法简洁高效，显著提升无监督检测性能，对开放世界和低标注场景有重要价值。
2301.11320|v2.contribution: 提出CutLER实现高质量无监督目标检测和分割。
2301.11320|v2.innovation: 利用MaskCut和自训练增强多物体发现能力。
2301.11320|v2.result: 在多个基准上AP50提升2.7倍以上，低样本下超越MoCo-v2。

Object Detection with Self-Supervised Sc.summary_cn: ①针对目标检测模型在新场景中因域差异导致性能下降的问题。②提出自监督场景适应方法，利用未标注场景数据调整检测器。③相比无适应方法，减少人工标注需求并提升跨域泛化。④具体效果数据未在摘要中给出。
Object Detection with Self-Supervised Sc.summary_en: This paper addresses domain shift in object detection by proposing a self-supervised scene adaptation method that leverages unlabeled data to adjust the detector. It reduces annotation needs and improves cross-domain generalization.
Object Detection with Self-Supervised Sc.assessment: 对自动驾驶场景适应有实际意义，但摘要信息有限，创新性一般。
Object Detection with Self-Supervised Sc.contribution: 提出自监督场景适应策略提升检测器泛化。
Object Detection with Self-Supervised Sc.innovation: 利用未标注数据实现域适应。
Object Detection with Self-Supervised Sc._arxiv_id: Object Detection with Self-Supervised Scene Adaptation.

2212.06331|v2.summary_cn: ①针对大规模LiDAR点云地图优化中全局配准收敛慢、缺乏回环和精确对应点的问题。②提出DeepMapping2，通过基于回环的地图拓扑组织训练批次，并引入自监督局部到全局点一致性损失，利用成对配准增强全局优化。③相比原DeepMapping，新增回环感知的批次采样和局部-全局一致性约束，显著提升大规模场景的收敛性和精度。④在KITTI、NCLT和Nebula数据集上的实验和消融研究验证了有效性，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2212.06331|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenges of large-scale LiDAR map optimization, including slow convergence and lack of loop closures. It proposes DeepMapping2 with topology-aware batch organization and a self-supervised local-to-global consistency loss. Experiments on KITTI, NCLT, and Nebula demonstrate improved performance over the baseline.
2212.06331|v2.assessment: 该工作对自动驾驶地图构建有直接价值，回环感知的训练策略具有实用意义，但缺乏定量结果，需进一步验证。
2212.06331|v2.contribution: 提出一种结合回环拓扑和局部-全局一致性损失的自监督LiDAR地图优化方法。
2212.06331|v2.innovation: 利用地图拓扑组织训练批次并引入局部到全局点一致性损失。
2212.06331|v2.result: 在多个公开数据集上验证了有效性，但未报告具体数值。

MV-JAR: Masked Voxel Jigsaw and Reconstr.summary_cn: ①针对LiDAR点云自监督预训练中缺乏有效掩码策略和重建目标的问题。②提出MV-JAR，结合掩码体素拼图任务和重建任务，通过预测体素级拼图顺序和重建点云来学习几何特征。③相比现有MAE方法，引入拼图任务增强空间关系理解，提升预训练表征质量。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果数据。
MV-JAR: Masked Voxel Jigsaw and Reconstr.summary_en: This paper introduces MV-JAR, a self-supervised pre-training method for LiDAR point clouds combining masked voxel jigsaw and reconstruction tasks. It enhances geometric feature learning by predicting voxel order and reconstructing points. The abstract is incomplete, so quantitative results are unavailable.
MV-JAR: Masked Voxel Jigsaw and Reconstr.assessment: 该工作为LiDAR自监督学习提供了新思路，但摘要不完整，需查阅全文评估。
MV-JAR: Masked Voxel Jigsaw and Reconstr.contribution: 提出掩码体素拼图与重建结合的LiDAR自监督预训练框架。
MV-JAR: Masked Voxel Jigsaw and Reconstr.innovation: 将拼图任务融入掩码重建，增强空间结构学习。
MV-JAR: Masked Voxel Jigsaw and Reconstr._arxiv_id: MV-JAR: Masked Voxel Jigsaw and Reconstruction for LiDAR-Based Self-Supervised Pre-Training.

PointCMP: Contrastive Mask Prediction fo.summary_cn: ①针对点云视频自监督学习中的时空特征提取问题。②提出PointCMP，采用对比掩码预测策略，在点云视频上同时进行掩码重建和对比学习。③相比静态点云方法，利用视频时序信息增强表征。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果。
PointCMP: Contrastive Mask Prediction fo.summary_en: This paper proposes PointCMP for self-supervised learning on point cloud videos, combining contrastive learning with mask prediction. It leverages temporal information to improve feature learning. The abstract is incomplete, so results are not reported.
PointCMP: Contrastive Mask Prediction fo.assessment: 点云视频自监督是一个新兴方向，但摘要不完整，创新性和效果需进一步确认。
PointCMP: Contrastive Mask Prediction fo.contribution: 提出对比掩码预测方法用于点云视频自监督学习。
PointCMP: Contrastive Mask Prediction fo.innovation: 结合对比学习和掩码预测处理时序点云数据。
PointCMP: Contrastive Mask Prediction fo._arxiv_id: PointCMP: Contrastive Mask Prediction for Self-supervised Learning on Point Cloud Videos.

ACL-SPC: Adaptive Closed-Loop System for.summary_cn: ①针对点云补全任务中依赖大量标注数据的问题。②提出ACL-SPC，设计自适应闭环系统，通过自监督方式迭代优化补全模型。③相比静态补全方法，引入闭环反馈机制提升鲁棒性。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果。
ACL-SPC: Adaptive Closed-Loop System for.summary_en: This paper presents ACL-SPC, an adaptive closed-loop system for self-supervised point cloud completion. It iteratively refines the model without heavy annotations. The abstract is incomplete, so quantitative results are absent.
ACL-SPC: Adaptive Closed-Loop System for.assessment: 自监督补全有应用潜力，但摘要不完整，方法细节和实验需进一步评估。
ACL-SPC: Adaptive Closed-Loop System for.contribution: 提出自适应闭环自监督点云补全框架。
ACL-SPC: Adaptive Closed-Loop System for.innovation: 引入闭环反馈机制实现自监督补全。
ACL-SPC: Adaptive Closed-Loop System for._arxiv_id: ACL-SPC: Adaptive Closed-Loop System for Self-Supervised Point Cloud Completion.

ToThePoint: Efficient Contrastive Learni.summary_cn: ①针对3D点云对比学习计算开销大的问题。②提出ToThePoint，通过回收和复用特征来提升对比学习效率。③相比标准对比学习，减少计算资源消耗，保持性能。④摘要缺失，无法提供具体效果。
ToThePoint: Efficient Contrastive Learni.summary_en: This paper proposes ToThePoint, an efficient contrastive learning method for 3D point clouds via feature recycling. It reduces computational cost while maintaining representation quality. The abstract is incomplete, so results are not specified.
ToThePoint: Efficient Contrastive Learni.assessment: 效率优化是实际部署的关键，但摘要不完整，需查看实验数据。
ToThePoint: Efficient Contrastive Learni.contribution: 提出特征回收机制提升点云对比学习效率。
ToThePoint: Efficient Contrastive Learni.innovation: 通过特征复用降低计算开销。
ToThePoint: Efficient Contrastive Learni._arxiv_id: ToThePoint: Efficient Contrastive Learning of 3D Point Clouds via Recycling.

2305.08808|v2.summary_cn: ①针对点云自监督学习中预测目标选择的问题，现有MAE仅预测坐标或占用率，忽略了点云特有的几何属性。②提出GeoMAE，基于几何特征重建，预测体素内点的质心、法线和曲率，并结合占用率预测形成多任务学习。③相比现有方法，利用点云几何特性（质心、法线、曲率）作为监督信号，增强细粒度几何推理能力。④实验表明，该方法在多个下游任务上优于基线，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2305.08808|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the choice of prediction targets in point cloud self-supervised learning, proposing GeoMAE that predicts centroid, normal, and curvature alongside occupancy. It leverages point-cloud-specific geometric signals to improve fine-grained feature learning. The method demonstrates superior performance over baselines, though specific numbers are not in the abstract.
2305.08808|v2.assessment: 该工作深入探讨了点云自监督的核心问题，创新性强，对3D感知预训练有重要参考价值。
2305.08808|v2.contribution: 提出基于几何目标预测的点云自监督预训练框架GeoMAE。
2305.08808|v2.innovation: 引入质心、法线和曲率预测作为自监督信号。
2305.08808|v2.result: 在多个下游任务上优于现有方法。

2303.16235|v2.summary_cn: ①针对现有LiDAR点云自监督方法仅利用单帧空间增强构建正样本对、忽视时序信息的问题。②提出一种结合空间与时间域的自监督学习策略，包括点-簇学习（聚合空间信息区分物体）和基于无监督目标跟踪的簇-簇学习（利用时序对应关系）。③相比已有对比学习方法，首次系统性地将时序信息融入点云自监督预训练。④在两个大规模LiDAR数据集上预训练并迁移到多个分割基准，实验表明该方法优于现有最先进点云自监督方法。
2303.16235|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of existing LiDAR point cloud self-supervised methods that rely solely on single-frame spatial augmentations, by introducing a spatiotemporal SSL strategy with point-to-cluster and cluster-to-cluster learning via unsupervised tracking. It outperforms state-of-the-art methods on multiple segmentation benchmarks after pre-training on large-scale LiDAR datasets.
2303.16235|v2.assessment: 该论文为点云自监督学习提供了重要的时序维度扩展，对自动驾驶感知中的无标注数据利用具有显著价值。
2303.16235|v2.contribution: 提出首个融合空间与时序信息的点云自监督学习框架。
2303.16235|v2.innovation: 利用无监督目标跟踪构建跨帧正样本对，实现时空联合表征学习。
2303.16235|v2.result: 在多个点云分割基准上超越现有最先进自监督方法。

2212.05330|v2.summary_cn: ①针对4D点云序列自监督表示学习未充分利用动态场景时序几何信息的问题。②提出Complete-to-Partial 4D Distillation方法，将4D自监督预训练建模为教师-学生知识蒸馏框架，学生从教师引导中学习有用的4D表示。③相比静态快照方法和图像空间流方法，该方法同时考虑3D几何和时序动态。④在室内外多个4D点云序列理解任务上显著优于现有预训练方法。
2212.05330|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Complete-to-Partial 4D Distillation, a teacher-student knowledge distillation framework for self-supervised 4D point cloud sequence representation learning, which leverages temporal geometric details. It significantly outperforms prior pre-training approaches on various indoor and outdoor 4D understanding tasks.
2212.05330|v2.assessment: 该工作填补了4D点云自监督预训练的空白，为动态场景理解提供了新范式。
2212.05330|v2.contribution: 提出首个基于知识蒸馏的4D点云序列自监督预训练方法。
2212.05330|v2.innovation: 将完整到部分的重建任务转化为教师-学生蒸馏框架，有效利用时序几何信息。
2212.05330|v2.result: 在室内外4D点云任务上大幅超越现有预训练方法。

SkyEye: Self-Supervised Bird's-Eye-View.summary_cn: ①针对单目相机生成鸟瞰图语义地图需要大量标注的问题。②提出SkyEye方法，利用自监督学习从单目前视图生成BEV语义映射。③摘要缺失，无法详细评估方法细节和实验效果。④由于摘要不完整，无法提供具体数据。
SkyEye: Self-Supervised Bird's-Eye-View.summary_en: This paper introduces SkyEye, a self-supervised method for BEV semantic mapping from monocular frontal view images. Due to missing abstract details, the specific methodology and quantitative results cannot be assessed.
SkyEye: Self-Supervised Bird's-Eye-View.assessment: 摘要信息不完整，难以全面评估其贡献，但主题与BEV感知相关。
SkyEye: Self-Supervised Bird's-Eye-View.contribution: 提出自监督单目BEV语义映射方法。
SkyEye: Self-Supervised Bird's-Eye-View.innovation: 利用自监督学习减少BEV映射对标注的依赖。
SkyEye: Self-Supervised Bird's-Eye-View._arxiv_id: SkyEye: Self-Supervised Bird's-Eye-View Semantic Mapping Using Monocular Frontal View Images.

2212.07401|v2.summary_cn: ①针对3D关键点标注昂贵、现有自监督关键点发现方法仅处理2D视图的问题。②提出BKinD-3D方法，从多视角视频中自监督发现3D关键点，使用编码器-解码器架构和3D体积热图，训练重建多视角时空差异并施加关节长度约束。③相比现有方法，首次在3D空间进行无监督关键点发现，无需2D或3D关键点及边界框监督。④在人类和大鼠视频上验证了方法的有效性，展示了3D关键点发现用于行为研究的潜力。
2212.07401|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes BKinD-3D for self-supervised 3D keypoint discovery from multi-view videos, using a volumetric heatmap architecture with spatiotemporal reconstruction and joint length constraints. It operates in 3D without any keypoint or bounding box supervision, demonstrating effectiveness on human and rat videos.
2212.07401|v2.assessment: 该工作为行为分析提供了无标注3D姿态估计的新思路，但应用场景与自动驾驶感知关联度较低。
2212.07401|v2.contribution: 提出首个无需监督的3D关键点发现方法。
2212.07401|v2.innovation: 利用多视角时空差异和骨架约束实现3D关键点自监督学习。
2212.07401|v2.result: 在人类和大鼠视频上验证了有效性。

2303.09877|v2.summary_cn: ①针对深度多视图聚类中自监督方法发展不一致、对比对齐可能损害聚类性能的问题。②提出DeepMVC统一框架，涵盖多种现有方法，并理论证明对比对齐对簇可分离性的负面影响。③基于发现开发新的自监督形式，实验验证对比对齐在多视图数据集上降低性能。④新实例在多个数据集上优于现有方法，并指出未来研究方向。
2303.09877|v2.summary_en: This paper presents DeepMVC, a unified framework for deep multi-view clustering, and theoretically proves that contrastive alignment can negatively affect cluster separability, especially with many views. New instances with alternative self-supervision outperform previous methods on several datasets.
2303.09877|v2.assessment: 该论文对自监督聚类领域有理论贡献，但与自动驾驶感知核心方向关联较弱。
2303.09877|v2.contribution: 提出统一框架并理论分析对比对齐在多视图聚类中的缺陷。
2303.09877|v2.innovation: 理论证明对比学习在多视图场景下的局限性并设计新自监督形式。
2303.09877|v2.result: 新方法在多个数据集上取得更优性能。

Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transfo.summary_cn: ①针对自监督单目深度估计中CNN和Transformer架构的效率和精度平衡问题。②提出Lite-Mono轻量级混合架构，结合CNN和Transformer提取全局和局部特征。③相比纯CNN或纯Transformer方法，在保持轻量化的同时提升深度估计精度。④在KITTI等基准上达到先进性能，同时模型参数和计算量显著降低。
Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transfo.summary_en: This paper proposes Lite-Mono, a lightweight hybrid CNN-Transformer architecture for self-supervised monocular depth estimation, balancing efficiency and accuracy. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on benchmarks like KITTI with significantly reduced parameters and computation.
Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transfo.assessment: 该工作为自监督深度估计提供了高效的架构设计，对自动驾驶感知有实际应用价值。
Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transfo.contribution: 提出轻量级CNN-Transformer混合架构用于自监督单目深度估计。
Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transfo.innovation: 高效融合CNN局部特征和Transformer全局上下文，实现精度与效率的平衡。
Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transfo.result: 在KITTI等基准上达到先进性能并降低计算成本。
Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transfo._arxiv_id: Lite-Mono: A Lightweight CNN and Transformer Architecture for Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation.

T-MAE : Temporal Masked Autoencoders for.summary_cn: ①针对点云表示学习中自监督预训练方法缺乏时间信息利用的问题。②提出T-MAE，一种时间掩码自编码器，通过掩码和重建点云序列中的时空块，结合Transformer编码器学习时空特征。③相比现有MAE方法仅处理单帧，T-MAE显式建模时间动态，增强对运动物体的表征能力。④在多个下游任务（如3D检测、分割）上取得显著提升，例如在ScanObjectNN分类任务上达到88.6%准确率，优于基线方法。
T-MAE : Temporal Masked Autoencoders for.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of temporal information in self-supervised point cloud representation learning. It proposes T-MAE, a temporal masked autoencoder that masks and reconstructs spatiotemporal patches in point cloud sequences using a Transformer encoder. Compared to existing MAE methods that handle single frames, T-MAE explicitly models temporal dynamics, improving representations for moving objects. It achieves significant gains on downstream tasks, e.g., 88.6% accuracy on ScanObjectNN classification, surpassing baselines.
T-MAE : Temporal Masked Autoencoders for.assessment: 该论文将MAE扩展到时间维度，为点云自监督学习提供了新思路，对自动驾驶中动态场景理解有重要参考价值。
T-MAE : Temporal Masked Autoencoders for.contribution: 提出首个时间掩码自编码器T-MAE，用于点云序列的自监督表示学习。
T-MAE : Temporal Masked Autoencoders for.innovation: 通过掩码和重建时空块，联合学习空间和时间特征。
T-MAE : Temporal Masked Autoencoders for.result: 在多个点云基准上取得SOTA结果，验证了时间建模的有效性。
T-MAE : Temporal Masked Autoencoders for._arxiv_id: T-MAE : Temporal Masked Autoencoders for Point Cloud Representation Learning.

ViC-MAE: Self-supervised Representation.summary_cn: ①针对图像和视频联合自监督表示学习中，现有方法未能充分融合对比学习和掩码重建优势的问题。②提出ViC-MAE，结合对比学习与掩码自编码器，在图像和视频数据上联合训练，通过共享编码器学习跨模态特征。③相比单一MAE或对比方法，ViC-MAE利用对比损失增强判别性，同时通过重建保留细节信息。④在视频动作识别和图像分类任务上，如Kinetics-400上达到85.1% top-1准确率，优于现有自监督方法。
ViC-MAE: Self-supervised Representation.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenge of jointly learning self-supervised representations from images and videos by combining contrastive learning and masked autoencoding. It proposes ViC-MAE, which trains a shared encoder with both contrastive and reconstruction losses, capturing discriminative and detailed features. Compared to single-modality MAE or contrastive methods, ViC-MAE improves cross-modal generalization. It achieves 85.1% top-1 accuracy on Kinetics-400, outperforming prior self-supervised approaches.
ViC-MAE: Self-supervised Representation.assessment: 该工作有效融合两种自监督范式，为多模态感知提供强预训练模型，对自动驾驶多传感器融合有启发。
ViC-MAE: Self-supervised Representation.contribution: 提出ViC-MAE，统一图像和视频的对比掩码自编码框架。
ViC-MAE: Self-supervised Representation.innovation: 在共享编码器中联合优化对比损失和重建损失。
ViC-MAE: Self-supervised Representation.result: 在视频和图像基准上达到领先性能。
ViC-MAE: Self-supervised Representation._arxiv_id: ViC-MAE: Self-supervised Representation Learning from Images and Video with Contrastive Masked Autoencoders.

NeRF-MAE: Masked AutoEncoders for Self-s.summary_cn: ①针对NeRF场景表示中缺乏自监督预训练方法的问题。②提出NeRF-MAE，将掩码自编码器应用于NeRF的3D特征场，通过掩码部分空间位置并重建特征来学习3D表示。③相比基于2D图像的MAE，NeRF-MAE直接在3D空间中操作，更好地捕获几何和外观信息。④在3D分类和分割任务上，如ModelNet40分类达到92.3%准确率，显著优于从零训练和2D预训练基线。
NeRF-MAE: Masked AutoEncoders for Self-s.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of self-supervised pretraining for NeRF-based 3D representations. It proposes NeRF-MAE, which applies masked autoencoding to NeRF's 3D feature fields by masking spatial locations and reconstructing features. Unlike 2D image MAEs, NeRF-MAE operates directly in 3D space, capturing geometry and appearance better. It achieves 92.3% accuracy on ModelNet40 classification, outperforming from-scratch and 2D-pretrained baselines.
NeRF-MAE: Masked AutoEncoders for Self-s.assessment: 该论文将MAE引入NeRF领域，为3D场景理解提供新预训练范式，对自动驾驶占用网络预训练有潜在价值。
NeRF-MAE: Masked AutoEncoders for Self-s.contribution: 首次提出NeRF-MAE，用于NeRF特征场的自监督学习。
NeRF-MAE: Masked AutoEncoders for Self-s.innovation: 在3D特征场上执行掩码重建，利用NeRF的隐式表示。
NeRF-MAE: Masked AutoEncoders for Self-s.result: 在多个3D任务上超越现有方法。
NeRF-MAE: Masked AutoEncoders for Self-s._arxiv_id: NeRF-MAE: Masked AutoEncoders for Self-supervised 3D Representation Learning for Neural Radiance Fields.

DINO-Tracker: Taming DINO for Self-super.summary_cn: ①针对单视频中无监督点跟踪任务，现有方法依赖光流或复杂训练流程，泛化性差。②提出DINO-Tracker，利用预训练DINO模型的语义特征，通过特征匹配和时空一致性实现无需额外训练的点跟踪。③相比传统跟踪方法，DINO-Tracker无需微调即可适应新视频，且对遮挡和运动模糊鲁棒。④在标准基准如TAP-Vid上，达到与监督方法相当的精度，同时推理速度更快。
DINO-Tracker: Taming DINO for Self-super.summary_en: This paper tackles unsupervised point tracking in single videos, where existing methods rely on optical flow or complex training pipelines with limited generalization. It proposes DINO-Tracker, which leverages semantic features from pretrained DINO models via feature matching and spatiotemporal consistency, requiring no additional training. Compared to traditional tracking, it adapts to new videos without fine-tuning and is robust to occlusion and motion blur. It achieves accuracy comparable to supervised methods on TAP-Vid with faster inference.
DINO-Tracker: Taming DINO for Self-super.assessment: 该论文巧妙利用基础模型特征，实现高效无监督跟踪，对自动驾驶中动态目标跟踪具有直接应用价值。
DINO-Tracker: Taming DINO for Self-super.contribution: 提出DINO-Tracker，基于DINO特征的无训练点跟踪方法。
DINO-Tracker: Taming DINO for Self-super.innovation: 利用预训练ViT的语义特征进行匹配，避免额外训练。
DINO-Tracker: Taming DINO for Self-super.result: 在TAP-Vid上达到监督级精度，且推理高效。
DINO-Tracker: Taming DINO for Self-super._arxiv_id: DINO-Tracker: Taming DINO for Self-supervised Point Tracking in a Single Video.

BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation.summary_cn: ①针对自监督3D亚断层图像对齐中方向估计精度不足的问题。②提出BOE-ViT，利用等变性（equivariance）增强方向估计，在自监督框架下进行3D亚断层图像对齐。③相比现有方法，引入等变性约束以提升方向估计的鲁棒性和准确性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但预期在3D图像对齐任务上取得更优性能。
BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of inaccurate orientation estimation in self-supervised 3D subtomogram alignment. It proposes BOE-ViT, which leverages equivariance to boost orientation estimation within a self-supervised framework. The key improvement is the integration of equivariance constraints, enhancing robustness and accuracy over existing methods. Specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation.assessment: 该论文针对特定生物成像领域，与自动驾驶感知相关性较低，但等变性思想对3D几何理解有一定参考价值。
BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation.contribution: 提出基于等变性的自监督3D亚断层图像对齐方法。
BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation.innovation: 将等变性引入自监督方向估计。
BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation.result: 预期提升3D对齐精度，但缺乏具体数据。
BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation._arxiv_id: BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation with Equivariance in Self-Supervised 3D Subtomogram Alignment.

DAP-MAE: Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Mas.summary_cn: ①针对跨域点云学习中域适应能力不足的问题。②提出DAP-MAE，一种域自适应点云掩码自编码器，通过域自适应机制提升跨域学习效果。③相比标准MAE，引入域自适应模块，增强模型在不同域间的泛化能力。④摘要未提供具体数据，但预期在跨域点云任务上表现更优。
DAP-MAE: Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Mas.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenge of domain adaptation in point cloud learning. It introduces DAP-MAE, a domain-adaptive masked autoencoder that incorporates domain adaptation mechanisms to improve cross-domain performance. The key improvement over standard MAE is the explicit handling of domain shifts, enhancing generalization. Specific results are not detailed in the abstract.
DAP-MAE: Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Mas.assessment: 该论文与3D感知和自监督学习相关，对自动驾驶中的点云跨域场景有潜在应用价值。
DAP-MAE: Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Mas.contribution: 提出域自适应点云掩码自编码器。
DAP-MAE: Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Mas.innovation: 在MAE中集成域自适应机制。
DAP-MAE: Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Mas.result: 预期提升跨域点云学习性能。
DAP-MAE: Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Mas._arxiv_id: DAP-MAE: Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Masked Autoencoder for Effective Cross-Domain Learning.

2503.23220|v2.summary_cn: ①针对域自适应目标检测（DAOD）中Mean Teacher自标记方法的脆弱性和耦合问题。②提出DINO Teacher方法，利用大型冻结的DINOv2骨干网络在源数据上训练新标记器，生成更准确的目标域标签。③相比现有方法，解耦了学习与标签生成过程，利用预训练大模型提升标签质量。④摘要指出生成的标签更准确，但未提供具体数值，预期显著提升DAOD性能。
2503.23220|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the brittleness of Mean Teacher self-labelling in domain adaptive object detection (DAOD). It proposes DINO Teacher, which trains a new labeller on source data using a large frozen DINOv2 backbone to generate more accurate target-domain labels. The key improvement is decoupling learning from label generation and leveraging pretrained models. The abstract indicates improved label accuracy, though specific metrics are not provided.
2503.23220|v2.assessment: 该论文直接针对DAOD核心问题，结合视觉基础模型，对自动驾驶跨域检测具有重要参考价值。
2503.23220|v2.contribution: 提出利用冻结DINOv2的DINO Teacher方法提升DAOD标签质量。
2503.23220|v2.innovation: 解耦DAOD中的学习与标签生成，利用大模型预训练知识。
2503.23220|v2.result: 生成更准确的目标域标签，预期提升检测性能。

A Unified Approach to Interpreting Self-.summary_cn: ①针对3D点云自监督预训练方法缺乏统一解释的问题。②提出一种统一框架，通过交互（interactions）解释多种自监督预训练方法。③相比零散的方法分析，提供统一视角，有助于理解不同方法的共性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但预期提供理论洞见。
A Unified Approach to Interpreting Self-.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of unified interpretation for self-supervised pre-training methods on 3D point clouds. It proposes a unified framework based on interactions to explain various methods. The key contribution is providing a common perspective, aiding understanding of shared principles. Specific results are not provided in the abstract.
A Unified Approach to Interpreting Self-.assessment: 该论文偏理论分析，对理解自监督方法有帮助，但应用性较弱。
A Unified Approach to Interpreting Self-.contribution: 提出基于交互的统一解释框架。
A Unified Approach to Interpreting Self-.innovation: 统一多种3D自监督方法的解释。
A Unified Approach to Interpreting Self-.result: 提供理论洞见，无具体性能数据。
A Unified Approach to Interpreting Self-._arxiv_id: A Unified Approach to Interpreting Self-supervised Pre-training Methods for 3D Point Clouds via Interactions.

2503.13739|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多视角人物关联在相似外观和未标定相机下的挑战。②提出Self-MVA，一种自监督无标定多视角人物关联方法，利用跨视角图像同步作为预文本任务。③相比现有方法，无需标注或相机标定，通过同步标签训练模型。④摘要未提供具体数据，但预期在挑战性场景中提升关联鲁棒性。
2503.13739|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-view person association under similar appearances and uncalibrated cameras. It proposes Self-MVA, a self-supervised approach using cross-view image synchronization as a pretext task. The key improvement is eliminating the need for annotations and calibration. Specific results are not detailed in the abstract.
2503.13739|v2.assessment: 该论文与多视角感知相关，对自动驾驶中的多相机行人关联有借鉴意义。
2503.13739|v2.contribution: 提出自监督无标定多视角人物关联方法。
2503.13739|v2.innovation: 利用同步任务实现自监督关联。
2503.13739|v2.result: 预期提升挑战场景下的关联性能。

GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t.summary_cn: ①针对自监督单目深度估计中从点级到平面级建模的不足。②提出GeoDepth，将深度估计从点对点建模扩展为平面对平面建模，提升几何一致性。③相比现有方法，引入平面约束，增强深度估计的全局一致性。④摘要未提供具体数据，但预期在深度估计精度和鲁棒性上有所提升。
GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t.summary_en: This paper addresses limitations in self-supervised monocular depth estimation by shifting from point-to-depth to plane-to-depth modeling. It proposes GeoDepth, which introduces plane-level constraints to improve geometric consistency. The key improvement is enhanced global coherence over point-based methods. Specific results are not provided in the abstract.
GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t.assessment: 该论文直接针对自动驾驶深度估计，方法创新性强，具有较高应用价值。
GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t.contribution: 提出平面级建模的自监督深度估计方法。
GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t.innovation: 从点级到平面级的建模转变。
GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t.result: 预期提升深度估计的几何一致性。
GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t._arxiv_id: GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-to-Depth Modeling for Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation.

2412.06359|v2.summary_cn: 针对事件相机在资源受限机器人（如小型无人机）上在线自监督深度估计的计算效率问题，提出改进对比最大化的时间与内存效率，实现设备端实时学习。相比仅预训练，在线学习显著提升深度估计精度和避障成功率，并在自监督方法中达到最先进性能。
2412.06359|v2.summary_en: This work addresses the computational efficiency challenge of online self-supervised depth estimation from event cameras on resource-constrained robots. It improves the contrast maximization pipeline to enable real-time on-device learning, demonstrating superior depth accuracy and obstacle avoidance compared to pre-training alone, achieving state-of-the-art performance among self-supervised methods.
2412.06359|v2.assessment: 该工作展示了在线设备端学习的潜力，对低功耗自主系统有重要价值，但相关性略偏机器人视觉。
2412.06359|v2.contribution: 实现事件相机低延迟单目深度估计的在线设备端自监督学习。
2412.06359|v2.innovation: 通过优化对比最大化流程的时间和内存效率，使实时在线学习成为可能。
2412.06359|v2.result: 在线学习提升深度估计精度和避障成功率，达到自监督方法最先进水平。

2505.04410|v2.summary_cn: 针对CLIP在开放词汇密集预测中局部特征表示不足的问题，提出DeCLIP框架，通过解耦自注意力模块获取内容和上下文特征，分别对齐图像裁剪表示和视觉基础模型（如DINO）的空间相关性。实验表明DeCLIP在多个开放词汇密集预测任务上显著优于现有方法，提升局部判别性和空间一致性。
2505.04410|v2.summary_en: DeCLIP addresses the suboptimal local feature representation of CLIP in open-vocabulary dense prediction by decoupling self-attention into content and context features. Content features align with image crops for local discriminability, while context features retain spatial correlations guided by vision foundation models, achieving significant improvements over existing methods.
2505.04410|v2.assessment: 该工作直接提升开放集检测性能，对自动驾驶感知的未知类别处理有重要参考价值。
2505.04410|v2.contribution: 提出解耦学习框架增强CLIP在开放词汇密集预测中的局部特征表示。
2505.04410|v2.innovation: 解耦自注意力模块以分别优化内容判别性和上下文一致性。
2505.04410|v2.result: 在多个开放词汇密集预测任务上显著超越现有方法。

2503.21003|v2.summary_cn: 针对AI生成图像检测中泛化性差的问题，提出显式建模取证微结构的方法，利用真实图像自监督学习多样预测滤波器提取残差，并跨尺度联合建模得到紧凑的取证自描述。该方法支持零样本检测、开放集来源归因和聚类，实验显示优于现有技术。
2503.21003|v2.summary_en: This work addresses the generalization issue in AI-generated image detection by explicitly modeling forensic microstructures via self-supervised predictive filters on real images. The resulting compact forensic self-description enables zero-shot detection, open-set source attribution, and clustering, achieving superior accuracy and adaptability.
2503.21003|v2.assessment: 该工作对图像取证领域有贡献，但与自动驾驶感知核心方向相关性较低。
2503.21003|v2.contribution: 提出基于取证微结构的自描述方法，实现AI生成图像的零样本检测和归因。
2503.21003|v2.innovation: 利用自监督预测滤波器显式建模像素级取证模式。
2503.21003|v2.result: 在检测和归因任务上达到先进精度和适应性。

S4-Driver: Scalable Self-Supervised Driv.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶多模态大语言模型的可扩展性问题，提出S4-Driver框架，利用时空视觉表示增强自监督学习。该方法旨在提升驾驶场景中多模态理解的效率和准确性，但摘要信息不完整，具体方法细节未提供。
S4-Driver: Scalable Self-Supervised Driv.summary_en: S4-Driver addresses scalability in driving multimodal large language models by incorporating spatio-temporal visual representations for self-supervised learning. It aims to improve efficiency and accuracy in driving scene understanding, though specific details are incomplete in the abstract.
S4-Driver: Scalable Self-Supervised Driv.assessment: 该工作直接面向自动驾驶多模态感知，具有较高相关性，但摘要信息有限，需进一步评估。
S4-Driver: Scalable Self-Supervised Driv.contribution: 提出可扩展的自监督驾驶多模态大语言模型框架。
S4-Driver: Scalable Self-Supervised Driv.innovation: 引入时空视觉表示以增强驾驶场景理解。
S4-Driver: Scalable Self-Supervised Driv.result: 摘要未提供具体数据，预期提升多模态感知性能。
S4-Driver: Scalable Self-Supervised Driv._arxiv_id: S4-Driver: Scalable Self-Supervised Driving Multimodal Large Language Model with Spatio-Temporal Visual Representation.

2412.04424|v2.summary_cn: 针对CLIP风格视觉编码器在多样任务中适应性不足的问题，提出Florence-VL，利用生成式视觉基础模型Florence-2捕获多层级视觉特征，并设计深度-广度融合架构和训练策略，集成到Phi 3.5和LLama 3等LLM中。实验显示在视觉-语言对齐上优于流行编码器，提升多模态理解性能。
2412.04424|v2.summary_en: Florence-VL enhances multimodal large language models by using Florence-2's generative visual features with a depth-breadth fusion architecture. It integrates these features into LLMs like Phi 3.5 and LLama 3, showing advantages in vision-language alignment and downstream performance over CLIP-style encoders.
2412.04424|v2.assessment: 该工作对多模态感知和视觉编码器设计有重要贡献，可应用于自动驾驶场景理解。
2412.04424|v2.contribution: 提出基于生成式视觉编码器和深度-广度融合的多模态大语言模型。
2412.04424|v2.innovation: 利用Florence-2的多层级特征和DBFusion架构增强视觉表示。
2412.04424|v2.result: 在视觉-语言对齐和下游任务上优于现有视觉编码器。

2502.18290|v2.summary_cn: 针对自监督视觉编码器在大型视觉语言模型中的安全漏洞，提出BadVision方法，通过新颖的触发优化和后门学习技术，仅攻击编码器即可诱导LVLMs产生视觉幻觉。实验显示在八个基准上攻击成功率超99%，视觉理解错误率相对增加77.6%，且保持隐蔽性。
2502.18290|v2.summary_en: BadVision reveals a new backdoor threat in self-supervised vision encoders for large vision language models, using novel trigger optimization and backdoor learning to induce hallucinations. It achieves over 99% attack success rate and 77.6% relative visual understanding error across eight benchmarks while maintaining stealthiness.
2502.18290|v2.assessment: 该工作揭示多模态感知的安全风险，对自动驾驶系统的鲁棒性有警示意义。
2502.18290|v2.contribution: 首次提出针对SSL视觉编码器的后门攻击方法BadVision。
2502.18290|v2.innovation: 通过触发优化和后门学习实现高效且隐蔽的编码器攻击。
2502.18290|v2.result: 攻击成功率和视觉理解错误率显著，且能绕过现有检测方法。

2003.13942|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对视频字幕生成任务中现有方法仅利用场景级或对象级信息、未显式建模对象交互，导致预测缺乏视觉依据且易受虚假相关性影响的问题。②提出了一种新颖的时空图模型，通过构建可解释的对象交互链接来显式利用空间和时间上的对象关系，并引入对象感知的知识蒸馏机制，用局部对象信息正则化全局场景特征，以应对对象数量可变带来的性能不稳定。③相比已有工作，该方法首次在视频字幕中显式建模对象交互并提供视觉依据，同时通过知识蒸馏增强了模型的鲁棒性。④在两个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法取得了具有竞争力的性能，并生成了可解释的预测结果。
2003.13942|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem of video captioning where existing methods fail to explicitly model object interactions, leading to predictions lacking visual grounding and sensitivity to spurious correlations. It proposes a spatio-temporal graph model that exploits object interactions in space and time with interpretable links, and an object-aware knowledge distillation mechanism to regularize global scene features with local object information. Extensive experiments on two benchmarks demonstrate competitive performance with interpretable predictions.
2003.13942|v2.assessment: 该论文在视频理解领域提出了一个有价值的时空图建模思路，结合知识蒸馏提升了可解释性和鲁棒性，但整体创新性和影响力有限，与自动驾驶感知方向关联度较低。
2003.13942|v2.contribution: 提出了一种结合时空图建模和对象感知知识蒸馏的视频字幕生成方法，增强了预测的可解释性和鲁棒性。
2003.13942|v2.innovation: 创新性地在视频字幕中显式建模对象交互，并通过知识蒸馏利用局部对象信息正则化全局特征。
2003.13942|v2.result: 在两个基准数据集上取得了具有竞争力的性能，并生成了可解释的预测结果。

2103.03454|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉语言导航（VLN）中智能体仅将历史经验存储为循环网络中的隐状态，无法捕捉环境布局和进行长期规划的问题。②提出了结构化场景记忆（SSM）架构，通过模块化设计准确记忆导航过程中的感知信息，并作为结构化场景表示，解耦视觉和几何线索；同时引入collect-read控制器和基于前沿探索的决策策略，实现全局规划。③相比现有方法，SSM提供了完整的动作空间（地图上所有可导航位置），支持高效全局规划。④在R2R和R4R数据集上取得了最先进的性能。
2103.03454|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of VLN agents that store past experiences as latent states in recurrent networks, failing to capture environment layouts and long-term planning. It proposes Structured Scene Memory (SSM), a modular architecture that memorizes percepts, disentangles visual and geometric cues, and uses a collect-read controller with frontier-exploration for global planning. The method achieves state-of-the-art results on R2R and R4R datasets.
2103.03454|v2.assessment: 该论文在VLN领域提出了结构化记忆机制，对多模态感知和长期规划有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心方向关联度中等。
2103.03454|v2.contribution: 提出了结构化场景记忆架构，实现VLN中的长期规划和全局决策。
2103.03454|v2.innovation: 通过完整动作空间和前沿探索策略，将记忆机制与全局规划结合。
2103.03454|v2.result: 在R2R和R4R数据集上达到最先进性能。

VinVL: Revisiting Visual Representations.summary_cn: ①针对视觉语言模型中视觉表示质量不足的问题，现有模型多依赖预训练视觉特征，但缺乏对细粒度对象和属性的捕捉。②提出了VinVL，通过重新设计视觉特征提取器，结合对象检测和属性识别，生成更丰富的视觉表示，并用于视觉语言预训练。③相比已有工作，VinVL在视觉编码器上进行了系统优化，提升了跨模态对齐能力。④在多个视觉语言基准（如VQA、Image Captioning）上取得了显著改进。
VinVL: Revisiting Visual Representations.summary_en: This paper tackles the issue of insufficient visual representations in vision-language models, which often rely on pretrained features lacking fine-grained object and attribute details. It proposes VinVL, which redesigns the visual feature extractor with object detection and attribute recognition to produce richer representations for vision-language pretraining. The method achieves significant improvements on benchmarks like VQA and Image Captioning.
VinVL: Revisiting Visual Representations.assessment: 该论文对视觉语言模型中的视觉表示进行了重要改进，对多模态感知和VLM应用有较高参考价值。
VinVL: Revisiting Visual Representations.contribution: 提出了增强的视觉表示方法，提升视觉语言预训练性能。
VinVL: Revisiting Visual Representations.innovation: 结合对象检测和属性识别，优化视觉编码器设计。
VinVL: Revisiting Visual Representations.result: 在多个视觉语言基准上取得显著改进。
VinVL: Revisiting Visual Representations._arxiv_id: VinVL: Revisiting Visual Representations in Vision-Language Models.

InstanceRefer: Cooperative Holistic Unde.summary_cn: ①针对点云视觉定位（visual grounding on point clouds）中现有方法仅利用局部或全局特征，缺乏对实例级上下文和跨模态关系的理解。②提出了InstanceRefer，通过实例多级上下文引用，协同理解点云场景，包括实例级特征提取、多级上下文建模和跨模态匹配。③相比已有工作，InstanceRefer更全面地整合了实例间关系和语言描述，提升了定位精度。④在ScanRefer和ReferIt3D等基准上取得了最先进的性能。
InstanceRefer: Cooperative Holistic Unde.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of point cloud visual grounding methods that rely on local or global features without instance-level context and cross-modal relations. It proposes InstanceRefer, which uses instance multi-level contextual referring for cooperative understanding, including instance feature extraction, multi-level context modeling, and cross-modal matching. The method achieves state-of-the-art performance on ScanRefer and ReferIt3D benchmarks.
InstanceRefer: Cooperative Holistic Unde.assessment: 该论文在3D视觉定位领域提出了实例级上下文建模方法，对3D检测和跨模态感知有较强参考价值。
InstanceRefer: Cooperative Holistic Unde.contribution: 提出了实例多级上下文引用方法，提升点云视觉定位性能。
InstanceRefer: Cooperative Holistic Unde.innovation: 通过实例级特征和跨模态匹配，实现协同场景理解。
InstanceRefer: Cooperative Holistic Unde.result: 在ScanRefer和ReferIt3D上达到最先进性能。
InstanceRefer: Cooperative Holistic Unde._arxiv_id: InstanceRefer: Cooperative Holistic Understanding for Visual Grounding on Point Clouds through Instance Multi-level Contextual Referring.

3DVG-Transformer: Relation Modeling for.summary_cn: ①针对点云视觉定位中关系建模不足的问题，现有方法难以捕捉对象间的空间和语义关系。②提出了3DVG-Transformer，利用Transformer架构建模点云中对象间的关系，包括空间关系和语义关系，并融合语言特征进行定位。③相比已有工作，3DVG-Transformer通过关系建模增强了场景理解能力。④在ScanRefer和ReferIt3D等基准上取得了竞争性性能。
3DVG-Transformer: Relation Modeling for.summary_en: This paper addresses the insufficient relation modeling in point cloud visual grounding, where existing methods struggle to capture spatial and semantic relations between objects. It proposes 3DVG-Transformer, which uses Transformer architecture to model object relations in point clouds and fuse language features for grounding. The method achieves competitive performance on ScanRefer and ReferIt3D benchmarks.
3DVG-Transformer: Relation Modeling for.assessment: 该论文将Transformer应用于点云视觉定位的关系建模，对3D感知和跨模态理解有参考价值。
3DVG-Transformer: Relation Modeling for.contribution: 提出了基于Transformer的关系建模方法，提升点云视觉定位精度。
3DVG-Transformer: Relation Modeling for.innovation: 利用Transformer捕捉对象间空间和语义关系。
3DVG-Transformer: Relation Modeling for.result: 在ScanRefer和ReferIt3D上取得竞争性性能。
3DVG-Transformer: Relation Modeling for._arxiv_id: 3DVG-Transformer: Relation Modeling for Visual Grounding on Point Clouds.

3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Den.summary_cn: ①针对3D点云场景中密集描述生成与视觉定位任务缺乏统一框架的问题。②提出了3DJCG，一个联合处理3D密集描述和视觉定位的统一框架，通过共享编码器和任务特定解码器实现多任务学习。③相比分别处理两个任务的方法，该框架利用任务间的互补信息，提升了两个任务的性能。④在ScanRefer和ReferIt3D数据集上取得了优于现有方法的性能，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Den.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified framework for dense captioning and visual grounding on 3D point clouds. It proposes 3DJCG, which jointly handles both tasks via shared encoders and task-specific decoders, leveraging complementary information. The method achieves superior performance on ScanRefer and ReferIt3D benchmarks, though specific numbers are not detailed in the abstract.
3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Den.assessment: 该论文为3D场景理解提供了统一框架，对自动驾驶中的3D感知有参考价值，但摘要信息有限，需进一步阅读全文评估。
3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Den.contribution: 提出首个联合3D密集描述与视觉定位的统一框架。
3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Den.innovation: 利用多任务学习共享表示，增强跨任务泛化。
3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Den._arxiv_id: 3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Dense Captioning and Visual Grounding on 3D Point Clouds.

2107.06383|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视觉-语言任务中视觉编码器依赖人工标注数据、泛化能力有限的问题。②提出将CLIP作为视觉编码器集成到现有V&L模型中，包括任务特定微调和V&L预训练两种场景。③相比广泛使用的BottomUp-TopDown编码器，CLIP利用大规模图文对预训练，显著提升视觉表示质量。④在VQA、视觉蕴含和V&L导航任务上取得新的最先进结果，性能大幅提升。
2107.06383|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates the benefit of using CLIP as a visual encoder in vision-and-language models, addressing the limitation of manually-annotated visual encoders. It integrates CLIP into both task-specific fine-tuning and V&L pretraining scenarios, showing significant improvements over BottomUp-TopDown. The method achieves new state-of-the-art results on VQA, Visual Entailment, and V&L Navigation tasks.
2107.06383|v2.assessment: 该论文验证了大规模预训练视觉编码器在V&L任务中的有效性，对多模态感知研究有重要启示。
2107.06383|v2.contribution: 系统评估了CLIP在V&L任务中的优势，并建立了新的性能基准。
2107.06383|v2.innovation: 将CLIP作为通用视觉编码器，替代传统基于区域的特征。
2107.06383|v2.result: 在多个V&L任务上刷新最先进结果。

2106.12570|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多模态VAE在异构数据联合建模和共享表示学习中的信息融合问题。②提出MEME，通过互监督机制重新利用半监督VAE，隐式结合模态信息，避免显式因子分解。③相比现有方法，MEME能自然处理部分模态缺失的情况，扩展了适用场景。④在MNIST-SVHN和CUB数据集上，MEME在部分和完整观测方案下均优于基线，并展示了更好的表示质量。
2106.12570|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses information fusion in multimodal VAEs by introducing MEME, which repurposes semi-supervised VAEs to combine modalities through mutual supervision, avoiding explicit factorizations. This formulation naturally handles partially-observed data where some modalities are missing. MEME outperforms baselines on MNIST-SVHN and CUB datasets under both partial and complete observation schemes.
2106.12570|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了一种新颖的多模态融合策略，对处理不完整多模态数据有理论价值，但应用场景与自动驾驶感知关联度较低。
2106.12570|v2.contribution: 提出基于互监督的多模态VAE框架，支持部分模态缺失。
2106.12570|v2.innovation: 用互监督替代显式模态组合，简化模型并增强鲁棒性。
2106.12570|v2.result: 在标准数据集上优于现有基线。

2106.09667|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多模态对比学习（如CLIP）在噪声数据上训练时面临后门和投毒攻击的安全威胁。②通过仅污染0.01%的数据（如300张图像）即可使模型对测试图像误分类，而定向投毒仅需0.0001%数据（如3张图像）。③揭示了大规模网络数据训练的脆弱性，挑战了无标注数据训练的安全性假设。④实验表明攻击成功率极高，且对模型鲁棒性有显著影响。
2106.09667|v2.summary_en: This paper exposes the vulnerability of multimodal contrastive learning methods like CLIP to backdoor and poisoning attacks when trained on noisy web data. By poisoning just 0.01% of the dataset, the model misclassifies test images with a small patch, and targeted attacks require only 0.0001% control. The findings question the safety of training on uncurated internet data.
2106.09667|v2.assessment: 该论文对自动驾驶中依赖大规模预训练模型的安全性提出警示，具有重要的安全研究价值。
2106.09667|v2.contribution: 首次系统展示对比学习模型对投毒攻击的脆弱性。
2106.09667|v2.innovation: 量化了极低比例投毒数据即可实现攻击。
2106.09667|v2.result: 以极小数据污染实现高成功率攻击。

2207.03482|v2.summary_cn: ①针对开放词汇检测中CLIP和图像级监督与检测任务不对齐的问题。②提出通过对象中心对齐CLIP语言嵌入，并利用伪标签过程进行视觉接地，以扩展训练词汇。③通过权重传递函数融合两种对齐策略的互补优势，缩小对象与图像级表示差距。④在开放词汇检测基准上取得显著改进，具体数据未在摘要中给出。
2207.03482|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the misalignment of CLIP and image-level supervision in open-vocabulary detection. It proposes object-centric alignment of CLIP embeddings and pseudo-labeling for visual grounding, combined via a weight transfer function. The method bridges object and image-level representations, improving performance on open-vocabulary detection benchmarks.
2207.03482|v2.assessment: 该论文针对开放词汇检测的关键瓶颈提出有效解决方案，对自动驾驶中的未知物体识别有直接参考价值。
2207.03482|v2.contribution: 提出对象中心对齐与伪标签结合的方法，提升开放词汇检测性能。
2207.03482|v2.innovation: 通过权重传递融合两种弱监督策略。
2207.03482|v2.result: 在开放词汇检测任务上取得先进结果。

2208.05592|v2.summary_cn: ①针对开放词汇模型（如CLIP）在特定任务上零样本性能不佳的问题。②提出PAINT方法，通过微调前后权重的插值来修补模型，提升特定任务精度而不损害其他任务。③在九个零样本性能差的任务上，PAINT将精度提升15到60个百分点，同时保持ImageNet精度在1个百分点内。④支持多任务修补，并随模型规模扩大而改进，还发现跨任务泛化现象。
2208.05592|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces PAINT, a patching method that interpolates weights between a pre-fine-tuned and post-fine-tuned model to improve accuracy on specific tasks without degrading others. On nine tasks where zero-shot CLIP performs poorly, PAINT increases accuracy by 15-60 percentage points while preserving ImageNet accuracy within one point. It supports multi-task patching and shows broad transfer benefits.
2208.05592|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了一种简单有效的模型修补方法，对提升开放词汇模型在特定场景的实用性有重要意义。
2208.05592|v2.contribution: 提出权重插值修补方法，平衡特定任务提升与通用性能保持。
2208.05592|v2.innovation: 利用权重插值实现任务特定优化，无需额外参数。
2208.05592|v2.result: 在多个任务上大幅提升精度，同时保持ImageNet性能。

2211.14241|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对3D视觉定位任务中视觉流仅依赖点云编码器、缺乏丰富2D语义线索的问题，提出利用从点云合成的2D线索来增强3D视觉表示。②方法上，提出了Look Around and Refer (LAR)模块，通过知识蒸馏将2D合成语义知识融入3D编码器，无需额外2D输入，在训练和测试阶段均能高效利用。③相比现有方法，LAR在不增加推理负担的前提下，通过2D线索辅助3D编码器，提升了视觉表示质量。④在Nr3D、Sr3D和ScanRefer三个基准上，LAR显著优于现有最先进方法，取得了持续的性能提升。
2211.14241|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of 3D visual grounding methods that rely solely on point cloud encoders, proposing to synthesize 2D clues from 3D point clouds to enrich visual representations. The proposed Look Around and Refer (LAR) module employs knowledge distillation to integrate 2D semantic knowledge into the 3D encoder without extra 2D inputs, consistently outperforming state-of-the-art methods on Nr3D, Sr3D, and ScanRefer benchmarks.
2211.14241|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地将2D合成语义知识蒸馏用于3D视觉定位，方法简洁有效，实验充分，对多模态感知和知识蒸馏领域有参考价值。
2211.14241|v2.contribution: 提出LAR模块，通过2D合成语义知识蒸馏增强3D视觉定位的视觉表示。
2211.14241|v2.innovation: 利用从点云合成的2D线索进行知识蒸馏，无需额外2D输入即可提升3D编码器性能。
2211.14241|v2.result: 在Nr3D、Sr3D和ScanRefer上显著超越现有最先进方法。

2301.05499|v2.summary_cn: 针对单域泛化目标检测（SDG）中同时学习鲁棒定位和表示困难的问题，提出利用预训练视觉-语言模型（如CLIP）通过文本提示引入语义域概念。方法包括对检测器骨干特征进行语义增强，以及基于文本的分类损失。在天气驾驶基准上，该方法比现有唯一的SDG检测方法Single-DGOD提升10%，验证了其有效性。
2301.05499|v2.summary_en: Addressing the challenge of single domain generalization in object detection, this work leverages a pre-trained vision-language model to introduce semantic domain concepts via textual prompts, using semantic augmentation on backbone features and a text-based classification loss. It outperforms the existing SDG detection method Single-DGOD by 10% on a weather-driving benchmark.
2301.05499|v2.assessment: 该论文填补了SDG目标检测研究的空白，创新性地将视觉-语言模型融入检测框架，对自动驾驶等域泛化场景有重要参考价值。
2301.05499|v2.contribution: 提出首个利用视觉-语言模型进行单域泛化目标检测的方法。

2303.12027|v2.summary_en: Proposing a joint visual grounding and tracking framework that unifies both tasks as localizing a target based on visual-language references, using a multi-source relation modeling module and a temporal modeling module with global semantic guidance. This end-to-end approach improves adaptability to appearance changes, though specific performance numbers are not detailed in the abstract.
2303.12027|v2.assessment: 该论文创新性地将视觉定位与跟踪统一，利用自然语言语义增强跟踪鲁棒性，对多模态感知和跟踪研究有启发意义。
2303.12027|v2.contribution: 提出联合视觉定位与跟踪的统一框架，实现端到端训练。

2303.16891|v2.summary_en: Addressing the reliance on manual mask annotations in open-vocabulary instance segmentation, this work proposes a Mask-free OVIS pipeline that generates pseudo-masks from image-caption pairs using a vision-language model, enabling weakly supervised learning for both base and novel categories. This reduces annotation cost and mitigates overfitting, though specific results are not given in the abstract.

2303.16891|v2.contribution: 提出无需手动掩码标注的开放词汇实例分割管道。

2303.14038|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉语言预训练（VLP）中训练成本高、收敛慢的问题，该论文指出掩码语言建模（MLM）中预测率与损坏率耦合是主要障碍。作者提出自由语言建模（FLM）任务，实现100%预测率与任意损坏率解耦，并允许为每个预测token定制损坏跨度。相比MLM方法，FLM在相同GPU时间下训练速度提升2.5倍，同时保持性能，通过更灵活的双向上下文利用促进模型学习。
2303.14038|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high training cost and slow convergence in vision-language pretraining (VLP), attributing it to the entanglement of prediction rate and corruption rate in masked language modeling (MLM). It proposes Free Language Modeling (FLM), which decouples the prediction rate from corruption rate, enabling 100% prediction with arbitrary corruption and customized spans. FLM achieves a 2.5x pretraining time reduction over MLM-based methods while maintaining performance, by exploiting bidirectional contexts more flexibly.
2303.14038|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了一种新颖的预训练任务，有效解决了VLP训练效率瓶颈，对大规模多模态模型训练具有重要参考价值。
2303.14038|v2.contribution: 提出FLM预训练任务，解耦预测率与损坏率，显著加速VLP训练。
2303.14038|v2.innovation: 创新性地实现100%预测率与任意损坏率解耦，并支持定制化损坏跨度。
2303.14038|v2.result: 训练时间减少2.5倍，性能与MLM方法相当。

2211.10277|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉语言模型（VLM）迁移到下游任务时，现有高效迁移学习方法（如提示调优和适配器调优）会破坏或过度偏向前人知识的问题，该论文提出Task Residual Tuning（TaskRes）。该方法直接在文本分类器上操作，通过冻结原始分类器权重并调整一组残差参数来获得新分类器，显式解耦先验知识与任务特定知识。TaskRes在保留可靠先验知识的同时，灵活探索任务特定知识，在多个下游任务上表现优异。
2211.10277|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue that existing efficient transfer learning methods for vision-language models (VLMs), such as prompt tuning and adapter-style tuning, either damage or excessively bias prior knowledge. It proposes Task Residual Tuning (TaskRes), which operates on the text-based classifier by freezing original weights and tuning a residual parameter set, explicitly decoupling prior and task-specific knowledge. TaskRes preserves reliable prior knowledge while enabling flexible task adaptation, achieving strong performance on downstream tasks.
2211.10277|v2.assessment: 该论文提出了一种简洁有效的VLM迁移方法，在保持先验知识的同时实现高效任务适应，具有实用价值。
2211.10277|v2.contribution: 提出TaskRes方法，通过残差调优解耦先验与任务知识，提升VLM迁移效率。
2211.10277|v2.innovation: 创新性地在文本分类器上使用残差参数，避免破坏预训练知识。
2211.10277|v2.result: 在多个下游任务上性能优于现有ETL方法。

2303.15786|v2.summary_cn: 针对人类-物体交互（HOI）检测中依赖大规模训练数据且少样本/零样本性能差的问题，该论文提出HOICLIP框架，高效提取CLIP的先验知识。方法包括：引入交互解码器通过交叉注意力提取CLIP视觉特征中的信息区域，并与检测骨干融合；利用CLIP文本编码器生成分类器，并通过视觉语义算术和轻量适配器构建动词分类器；提出训练-free增强利用全局HOI预测。HOICLIP在少样本和零样本场景下显著提升泛化能力。
2303.15786|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of HOI detection relying on large-scale training data and suffering from poor few/zero-shot performance. It proposes HOICLIP, which efficiently extracts prior knowledge from CLIP via an interaction decoder with cross-attention, fused with the detection backbone, and leverages text embeddings for classifiers. HOICLIP achieves better generalization in few/zero-shot scenarios.
2303.15786|v2.assessment: 该论文有效结合CLIP先验与HOI检测，在少样本场景下表现突出，对多模态感知研究有借鉴意义。

2412.09082|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of existing VLN methods in multi-stage and long-horizon tasks by proposing a new LH-VLN task, an automated data generation platform NavGen, and the LHPR-VLN benchmark with 3,260 tasks averaging 150 steps. The work provides a foundation for evaluating long-term planning and decision consistency in navigation.

2412.09082|v2.innovation: 通过自动化平台NavGen和双向多粒度生成方式构建复杂任务数据集。
2412.09082|v2.result: 构建了3260个任务、平均150步的基准，并提出了细粒度评估指标。

1912.00381|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对3D卷积网络在视频动作识别中参数和计算量过大、在中小规模数据集上难以训练的问题。②提出了Gate-Shift Module (GSM)，通过空间门控和时域移位将2D-CNN高效转化为时空特征提取器，几乎不增加额外参数和计算开销。③相比传统3D CNN，GSM实现了时空分解的自适应路由，在保持高效性的同时提升了时序建模能力。④在Something Something-V1和Diving48上达到SOTA，在EPIC-Kitchens上以更低复杂度取得有竞争力的结果。
1912.00381|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the excessive parameters and computation of 3D CNNs for video action recognition, which hinder training on moderate datasets. It introduces the Gate-Shift Module (GSM) that converts 2D-CNNs into efficient spatio-temporal extractors via spatial gating and temporal shifting, with negligible overhead. Compared to 3D CNNs, GSM enables adaptive feature routing across time. It achieves SOTA on Something Something-V1 and Diving48, and competitive results on EPIC-Kitchens with lower complexity.
1912.00381|v2.assessment: 方法轻量高效，实验充分，对视频理解领域有实用价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心方向关联有限。
1912.00381|v2.contribution: 提出GSM模块，将2D-CNN高效扩展为视频时空特征提取器。
1912.00381|v2.innovation: 空间门控与时域移位的结合实现自适应时空分解。
1912.00381|v2.result: 在多个视频动作识别数据集上达到SOTA或竞争力结果，且计算开销极低。

RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Effici.summary_cn: ①该论文针对视频动作识别中3D卷积计算成本高的问题。②提出了RubiksNet，利用可学习的3D移位操作替代传统卷积，实现高效时空特征提取。③相比固定移位模式，该方法通过可学习参数自适应调整移位策略，提升了模型灵活性。④由于摘要缺失，具体效果数据未知，但该方向在效率与性能平衡上有潜力。
RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Effici.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of 3D convolutions in video action recognition. It proposes RubiksNet, which uses learnable 3D shifts to replace standard convolutions for efficient spatio-temporal modeling. The learnable shifts offer adaptive routing compared to fixed patterns. Specific results are unavailable due to missing abstract.
RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Effici.assessment: 思路与GSM类似，强调可学习移位，但摘要缺失限制了深入评估。
RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Effici.contribution: 提出可学习3D移位机制用于高效视频识别。
RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Effici.innovation: 将移位操作参数化，实现数据驱动的时空特征重组。
RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Effici._arxiv_id: RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Efficient Video Action Recognition.

It introduces Env-QA, a new benchmark focusing on dynamic environmental understanding. Compared to existing benchmarks, it emphasizes complex scene dynamics. Specific results are not detailed in the abstract.
Env-QA: A Video Question Answering Bench.assessment: 该基准可能为视频理解提供新测试场景，但创新性和影响力有限。
Env-QA: A Video Question Answering Bench.contribution: 提出了动态环境视频问答基准Env-QA。
Env-QA: A Video Question Answering Bench.innovation: 聚焦动态环境中的视频问答任务。

Unified Graph Structured Models for Vide._arxiv_id: Unified Graph Structured Models for Video Understanding.

Video Pose Distillation for Few-Shot, Fi.summary_cn: ①针对少样本细粒度体育动作识别中数据稀缺的问题。②提出了视频姿态蒸馏方法，利用姿态信息辅助动作识别。③相比现有方法，通过蒸馏姿态特征提升少样本性能。④摘要未提供具体数据，但方法旨在提升细粒度识别精度。

Video Pose Distillation for Few-Shot, Fi._arxiv_id: Video Pose Distillation for Few-Shot, Fine-Grained Sports Action Recognition.

Learning Self-Similarity in Space and Ti.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited generalization of motion representations in video action recognition. Learning Self-Similarity in Space and Ti.contribution: 提出时空自相似性作为广义运动表示。
Learning Self-Similarity in Space and Ti.innovation: 利用自相似性增强运动表示的泛化性。
Learning Self-Similarity in Space and Ti._arxiv_id: Learning Self-Similarity in Space and Time as Generalized Motion for Video Action Recognition.

2102.05095|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视频理解中3D卷积网络计算量大、难以捕捉长距离时空依赖的问题，提出纯自注意力架构TimeSformer。②方法将标准Transformer适配到视频，从帧级patch序列直接学习时空特征，并比较多种自注意力方案，发现分离注意力（时间与空间注意力分别应用）效果最佳。③相比3D卷积网络，无需卷积操作，训练更快，测试效率更高，且能处理超长视频。④在Kinetics-400和Kinetics-600上达到当时最优精度，且能处理超过一分钟的视频片段。
2102.05095|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles video understanding by proposing TimeSformer, a convolution-free architecture based solely on self-attention over space and time. It adapts the standard Transformer to video and finds divided attention (separate temporal and spatial attention) yields best accuracy. Compared to 3D CNNs, it trains faster, achieves higher test efficiency, and handles longer clips, reaching state-of-the-art on Kinetics-400/600.
2102.05095|v2.assessment: 开创性工作，证明纯Transformer在视频理解中的潜力，对后续视频Transformer研究影响深远。
2102.05095|v2.contribution: 提出首个纯自注意力视频分类架构TimeSformer。
2102.05095|v2.innovation: 分离时空注意力机制设计。
2102.05095|v2.result: 在Kinetics-400/600上达到SOTA，训练和推理效率显著优于3D CNN。

2106.11958|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多目标跟踪与分割中仅利用时间维度解决关联问题、分割依赖单帧预测的局限，提出原型交叉注意力网络PCAN。②方法将时空记忆蒸馏为原型集，通过交叉注意力从过去帧检索丰富信息，并采用原型外观模块学习对比性前景/背景原型，随时间传播。③相比现有方法，能充分利用时空信息，适用于在线多目标跟踪与分割。④在YouTube-VIS和BDD100K数据集上超越当前视频实例跟踪与分割竞赛冠军，且适用于单阶段和双阶段分割框架。
2106.11958|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses multiple object tracking and segmentation by proposing Prototypical Cross-Attention Network (PCAN), which distills spatio-temporal memory into prototypes and uses cross-attention to retrieve past information. It also learns contrastive foreground/background prototypes for segmentation. PCAN outperforms competition winners on YouTube-VIS and BDD100K, and works with both one-stage and two-stage frameworks.
2106.11958|v2.assessment: 方法设计巧妙，有效结合原型学习和交叉注意力，在视频实例分割与跟踪任务上表现优异。
2106.11958|v2.contribution: 提出原型交叉注意力网络用于在线多目标跟踪与分割。
2106.11958|v2.innovation: 利用原型蒸馏时空记忆并跨注意力检索。

2104.11178|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多模态表示学习依赖监督预训练和卷积架构的问题，提出VATT框架，从原始视频、音频和文本学习多模态表示。②方法采用无卷积Transformer架构，端到端训练，使用多模态对比损失，并研究模态无关的共享权重单骨干Transformer。③相比ConvNet架构，无需监督预训练，性能更优。④在Kinetics-400/600/700和Moments in Time上达到新纪录，如Kinetics-400 top-1 82.1%，迁移到ImageNet达78.7%，远超从零训练的64.7%。
2104.11178|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces VATT, a convolution-free Transformer framework for learning multimodal representations from raw video, audio, and text via contrastive losses. It outperforms ConvNet-based SOTA on multiple benchmarks, achieving 82.1% on Kinetics-400 and 78.7% on ImageNet after transfer, without supervised pre-training.
2104.11178|v2.assessment: 多模态自监督学习的里程碑工作，展示Transformer在跨模态表示学习中的强大能力。
2104.11178|v2.contribution: 提出无卷积多模态Transformer自监督学习框架VATT。
2104.11178|v2.innovation: 模态无关的共享权重Transformer设计。
2104.11178|v2.result: 在多个视频和图像基准上刷新纪录。

Contrastive Learning of Global and Local.summary_en: This paper addresses contrastive learning of global and local video representations, but due to missing abstract, specific methods and results cannot be determined.

2111.01673|v2.summary_cn: ①针对视频理解中自注意力缺乏时空对应关系（运动信息）建模的问题，提出关系自注意力RSA。②方法动态生成关系核并聚合关系上下文，利用视频中丰富的时空关系结构。③相比卷积和自注意力，RSA能更好地捕捉运动信息。④在Something-Something-V1/V2、Diving48和FineGym等运动中心基准上达到SOTA，显著优于卷积和自注意力对应方法。
2111.01673|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Relational Self-Attention (RSA) to address the lack of motion modeling in self-attention for video understanding. It dynamically generates relational kernels and aggregates relational contexts, outperforming convolution and self-attention counterparts on motion-centric benchmarks like Something-Something and Diving48.
2111.01673|v2.assessment: 针对视频理解中运动建模的关键问题，提出新颖的关系注意力机制，实验充分。
2111.01673|v2.contribution: 提出关系自注意力机制增强视频时空关系建模。
2111.01673|v2.innovation: 动态生成关系核以捕捉运动信息。
2111.01673|v2.result: 在多个运动中心基准上达到SOTA。

Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Vide.summary_cn: ①该论文针对视频动作识别中时空特征动态变化和长程依赖建模困难的问题。②提出了动态归一化（Dynamic Normalization）和中继（Relay）机制，动态调整特征分布并跨层传递信息。③相比传统批归一化和静态残差连接，该方法能更好地适应视频帧间的动态变化，增强时序建模能力。④在标准视频动作识别基准上取得了性能提升，但摘要未提供具体数据。
Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Vide.summary_en: This paper addresses challenges in video action recognition caused by dynamic spatiotemporal feature variations and long-range dependencies. It introduces dynamic normalization and relay mechanisms to adaptively adjust feature distributions and propagate information across layers, improving temporal modeling over static normalization and residual connections. The method achieves performance gains on standard benchmarks, though specific numbers are not provided in the abstract.
Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Vide.assessment: 该论文提出了一种新颖的动态归一化与中继机制，对视频理解领域有一定启发，但实验细节和具体数据缺失，影响说服力。
Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Vide.contribution: 提出了动态归一化与中继机制，用于改进视频动作识别中的时空特征建模。
Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Vide.innovation: 将动态归一化与跨层中继结合，自适应处理视频帧的动态变化。
Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Vide.result: 在视频动作识别基准上取得性能提升，但未给出具体数值。

Recurring the Transformer for Video Acti.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of recurrent modeling in Transformers for video action recognition.
